name: sin_ge_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem
statement:
private lemma sin_ge_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem {θ : ℝ} (hlo : Real.pi / 3 ≤ θ)
    (hhi : θ ≤ 2 * Real.pi / 3) : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 ≤ Real.sin θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  by_cases h : θ ≤ Real.pi / 2
  · exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) h hlo
  · push Not at h
    rw [show θ = Real.pi - (Real.pi - θ) by ring, Real.sin_pi_sub]
    exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
      (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)

name: sin_gt_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem
statement:
private lemma sin_gt_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem {θ : ℝ} (hlo : Real.pi / 3 < θ)
    (hhi : θ < 2 * Real.pi / 3) : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < Real.sin θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  by_cases h : θ ≤ Real.pi / 2
  · exact Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) h hlo
  · push Not at h
    rw [show θ = Real.pi - (Real.pi - θ) by ring, Real.sin_pi_sub]
    exact Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two
      (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)

name: g_rho'_arc_im
proof:
:= by
  rw [g_rho'_arc_value ht1 ht3]
  simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.exp_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul,
    add_im, ofReal_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, add_zero, zero_add]

name: g_rho'_im_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h1 | h1
  · have ht1 : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 hne
    rw [g_rho'_seg0_value h1, mul_comm, Complex.I_mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re]
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · rcases lt_or_ge t 3 with h3 | h3
    · rw [g_rho'_arc_im H h1 h3]
      linarith [sin_ge_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem (θ := Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6)
        (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])]
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h3 with rfl | h3'
      · simp [fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho, ellipticPointRho', ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']
      · rcases le_or_gt t 4 with h4 | h4
        · rw [g_rho'_seg3_value h3' h4]
          simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_zero,
            zero_add, neg_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
        · rw [g_rho'_seg4_value h4]
          simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re,
            Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero]
          linarith

name: g_rho'_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h_eq
  rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h1 | h1
  · have ht1 : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 hne
    rw [g_rho'_seg0_value h1] at h_eq
    have := congr_arg Complex.im h_eq; simp at this
    rcases this with h | h <;> linarith
  · rcases lt_or_ge t 3 with h3 | h3
    · have him_pos : 0 < (fdBoundary_H H t - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne).im := by
        rw [g_rho'_arc_im H h1 h3]
        linarith [sin_gt_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem (θ := Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6)
          (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])]
      rw [h_eq] at him_pos
      simp only [Complex.zero_im, lt_irrefl] at him_pos
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h3 with rfl | h3'
      · simp [fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho, ellipticPointRho', ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
          Complex.ext_iff] at h_eq
        linarith
      · rcases le_or_gt t 4 with h4 | h4
        · rw [g_rho'_seg3_value h3' h4] at h_eq
          have := congr_arg Complex.re h_eq; simp at this
        · rw [g_rho'_seg4_value h4] at h_eq
          have := congr_arg Complex.im h_eq; simp at this; linarith

name: g_rho'_slitPlane
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
  right
  rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h1 | h1
  · have ht1 : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 hne1
    rw [g_rho'_seg0_value h1, mul_comm, Complex.I_mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re]
    exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
  · rcases lt_or_ge t 3 with h3 | h3
    · rw [g_rho'_arc_im H h1 h3]
      have := sin_gt_sqrt3_div_2_of_mem (θ := Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6)
        (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h3 with rfl | h3'
      · exact absurd rfl hne3
      · rcases le_or_gt t 4 with h4 | h4
        · rw [g_rho'_seg3_value h3' h4]
          simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_zero,
            zero_add, neg_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
          exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
        · rw [g_rho'_seg4_value h4]
          simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re,
            Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero]
          exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)

name: arg_approach_rho'_left
statement:
private lemma arg_approach_rho'_left (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne).arg = Real.pi / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [g_rho'_seg0_value (by linarith : 1 - δ ≤ 1), show (1 - (1 - δ)) = δ by ring]
  exact arg_ofReal_mul_I (by nlinarith)

name: g_rho'_norm_seg0_at
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_norm_seg0_at (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = δ * (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g_rho'_seg0_value (by linarith : 1 - δ ≤ 1), show (1 - (1 - δ)) = δ by ring,
    norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hδ.le (by linarith))]

name: rho'_arc_factor
statement:
private lemma rho'_arc_factor (δ : ℝ) :
    (↑(Real.cos (Real.pi * (1 + (1 + δ)) / 6)) +
        ↑(Real.sin (Real.pi * (1 + (1 + δ)) / 6)) * I -
        (↑(1/2 : ℝ) + ↑(Real.sqrt 3 / 2) * I) : ℂ) =
      ↑(2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12)) *
        (↑(Real.cos (5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12)) +
         ↑(Real.sin (5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12)) * I)
proof:
:= by
  set θ : ℝ := Real.pi * (1 + (1 + δ)) / 6 with hθ_def
  set φ := Real.pi / 3 + δ * Real.pi / 12 with hφ_def
  have hθ_eq : θ = Real.pi / 3 + δ * Real.pi / 6 := by simp only [hθ_def]; ring
  have h_cos_sub : Real.cos θ - 1 / 2 = -2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12) * Real.sin φ := by
    have h := Real.cos_sub_cos θ (Real.pi / 3)
    rw [show (θ + Real.pi / 3) / 2 = φ by simp only [hφ_def, hθ_eq]; ring,
        show (θ - Real.pi / 3) / 2 = δ * Real.pi / 12 by rw [hθ_eq]; ring] at h
    linarith [Real.cos_pi_div_three]
  have h_sin_sub : Real.sin θ - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 =
      2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12) * Real.cos φ := by
    have h := Real.sin_sub_sin θ (Real.pi / 3)
    rw [show (θ - Real.pi / 3) / 2 = δ * Real.pi / 12 by rw [hθ_eq]; ring,
        show (θ + Real.pi / 3) / 2 = φ by simp only [hφ_def, hθ_eq]; ring] at h
    linarith [Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  have h_neg_sin_eq : -Real.sin φ = Real.cos (5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12) := by
    rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12 = Real.pi / 2 + φ by simp only [hφ_def]; ring,
      Real.cos_add, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
    ring
  have h_cos_eq : Real.cos φ = Real.sin (5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12) := by
    rw [show 5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ * Real.pi / 12 = Real.pi / 2 + φ by simp only [hφ_def]; ring,
      Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
    ring
  rw [← h_neg_sin_eq, ← h_cos_eq]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [add_re, sub_re, mul_re, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero, mul_one]
    linarith [h_cos_sub]
  · simp only [add_im, sub_im, mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_one]
    linarith [h_sin_sub]

name: arg_approach_rho'_right_helper
proof:
:= by
  rw [g_rho'_arc_value (by linarith) (by linarith), Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, rho'_arc_factor δ,
    Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]
  have h_sin_pos : 0 < Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12) :=
    sin_delta_pi_div_twelve_pos hδ hδ_small
  exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) h_sin_pos)
    ⟨by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos], by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩

name: g_rho'_norm_arc
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_norm_arc {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ2 : δ < 2) :
    ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = 2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12)
proof:
:= by
  rw [g_rho'_arc_value (by linarith : 1 < 1 + δ) (by linarith : 1 + δ < 3),
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, rho'_arc_factor δ, ← Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  exact norm_two_sin_mul_exp hδ hδ2

name: g_rho'_norm_arc_full
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_norm_arc_full {t : ℝ} (ht1 : 1 < t) (ht3 : t < 3) :
    ‖fdBoundary_H H t - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = 2 * Real.sin ((t - 1) * Real.pi / 12)
proof:
:= by
  convert g_rho'_norm_arc (δ := t - 1) (by linarith) (by linarith) using 2 <;> ring_nf

name: g_rho'_norm_ge_seg4
proof:
:= by
  have him : (fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).im = H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht4 with rfl | ht4'
    · have : fdBoundary_H H 4 - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ) =
          -1 + ↑(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) * I := by
        rw [fdBoundary_H_at_four]
        simp only [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne', UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk]
        push_cast; ring
      rw [this, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.one_im, mul_comm,
        Complex.I_mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re]; ring
    · rw [g_rho'_seg4_value ht4']
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re,
        Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, mul_one]
  calc H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 = |(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 : ℝ)| := (abs_of_pos (by linarith)).symm
    _ = |(fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).im| := by rw [him]
    _ ≤ ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _

name: g_rho'_norm_ge_one_seg3
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_norm_ge_one_seg3 {t : ℝ} (ht3 : 3 ≤ t) (ht4 : t ≤ 4) :
    1 ≤ ‖fdBoundary_H H t - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht3 with rfl | ht3'
  · rw [fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho]
    simp only [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
      ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho', UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk]
    have : (-1/2 + ↑(Real.sqrt 3) / 2 * I - (1/2 + ↑(Real.sqrt 3) / 2 * I) : ℂ) = -1 := by
      ring
    rw [this, norm_neg, norm_one]
  · have hre : (fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).re = -1 := by
      rw [g_rho'_seg3_value (H := H) ht3' ht4]
      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im]
    calc 1 = |(-1 : ℝ)| := by norm_num
      _ = |(fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).re| := by rw [hre]
      _ ≤ ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _

name: g_rho'_arc_right_triple
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_arc_right_triple (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H)
    {δ_R : ℝ} (hδ_R : 0 < δ_R) :
    (∀ t ∈ Icc (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ),
      0 ≤ (fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).im) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ),
      fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ) ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Ioo (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ),
      fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ) ∈ slitPlane)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩
    exact g_rho'_im_nonneg hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith)
  · intro t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩
    exact g_rho'_ne_zero hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith)
  · intro t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩
    exact g_rho'_slitPlane hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: g_rho'_seg3_triple
statement:
private lemma g_rho'_seg3_triple (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) :
    (∀ t ∈ Icc (3:ℝ) 4,
      0 ≤ (fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)).im) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc (3:ℝ) 4,
      fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ) ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Ioo (3:ℝ) 4,
      fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ) ∈ slitPlane)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩
    exact g_rho'_im_nonneg hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith)
  · intro t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩
    exact g_rho'_ne_zero hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith)
  · intro t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩
    exact g_rho'_slitPlane hH ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: g_rho'_seg4_slit
proof:
:= fun t ⟨ht4, ht5⟩ =>
  g_rho'_slitPlane hH ⟨by linarith, ht5⟩ (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: ftc_logDeriv_telescope_rho_plus_one
proof:
:= fun t => fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume 0 (1 - δ_L) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume (1 + δ_R) 5 ∧
    ((∫ t in (0:ℝ)..(1 - δ_L), deriv g t / g t) + (∫ t in (1 + δ_R)..(5:ℝ), deriv g t / g t) =
    Complex.log (g (1 - δ_L)) - Complex.log (g (1 + δ_R))) := by
  intro g
  set ρ' : ℂ := ellipticPointRhoPlusOne with hρ'_def
  set h₀ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => ↑((1 - t) * (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)) * I
  set h₁ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I) - ρ'
  set h₂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => -1 + ↑((t - 3) * (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)) * I
  set h₃ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => ↑(t - 5) + ↑(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) * I
  have hg_eq_h₀ : ∀ t, t ≤ 1 → g t = h₀ t := fun t ht => by
    change fdBoundary_H H t - ρ' = h₀ t; rw [g_rho'_seg0_value ht]
  have hg_eq_h₁ : ∀ t, 1 < t → t < 3 → g t = h₁ t := fun t ht1 ht3 => by
    change fdBoundary_H H t - ρ' = h₁ t
    rw [g_rho'_arc_value ht1 ht3]
    simp only [h₁, hρ'_def, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
      UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk]
    push_cast; ring
  have hg_eq_h₂ : ∀ t, 3 < t → t ≤ 4 → g t = h₂ t := fun t ht3 ht4 => by
    change fdBoundary_H H t - ρ' = h₂ t; rw [g_rho'_seg3_value ht3 ht4]
  have hg_eq_h₃ : ∀ t, 4 < t → g t = h₃ t := fun t ht4 => by
    change fdBoundary_H H t - ρ' = h₃ t; rw [g_rho'_seg4_value ht4]
  have hg0 : g 0 = h₀ 0 := hg_eq_h₀ 0 (by norm_num)
  have hg1mδ : g (1 - δ_L) = h₀ (1 - δ_L) := hg_eq_h₀ (1 - δ_L) (by linarith)
  have hg1pδ : g (1 + δ_R) = h₁ (1 + δ_R) := hg_eq_h₁ (1 + δ_R) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hg3_1 : g 3 = h₁ 3 := by
    change fdBoundary_H H 3 - ρ' = h₁ 3
    rw [fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho]
    simp only [h₁, hρ'_def, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
      ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho', UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk,
      show Real.pi * (1 + 3) / 6 = 2 * Real.pi / 3 by ring]
    rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, cos_two_pi_div_three, sin_two_pi_div_three]
    push_cast; ring
  have hg3_2 : g 3 = h₂ 3 := by
    change fdBoundary_H H 3 - ρ' = h₂ 3
    rw [fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho]
    simp only [h₂, hρ'_def, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
      ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho', UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk]
    push_cast; ring
  have hg4_2 : g 4 = h₂ 4 := hg_eq_h₂ 4 (by linarith) le_rfl
  have hg4_3 : g 4 = h₃ 4 := by
    change fdBoundary_H H 4 - ρ' = h₃ 4
    rw [fdBoundary_H_at_four H]
    simp only [hρ'_def, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne',
      UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk, h₃]
    push_cast; ring
  have hg5 : g 5 = h₃ 5 := hg_eq_h₃ 5 (by norm_num)
  have hd_h₀ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h₀ (-(↑(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) : ℂ) * I) t :=
    hasDerivAt_aff_imI_neg (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) 1
  have hd_h₁ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h₁
      (↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I)) t :=
    fun t => hasDerivAt_arc_sub_const ρ' t
  have hd_h₂ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h₂ ((↑(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) : ℂ) * I) t := fun t =>
    ((hasDerivAt_const t (-1:ℂ)).add
      (hasDerivAt_aff_imI_pos (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) 3 t)).congr_deriv (by simp [zero_add])
  have hd_h₃ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h₃ 1 t :=
    hasDerivAt_seg5_line 5 (↑(H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) * I)
  have heq_0_1mδ : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) (1 - δ_L),
      g t = h₀ t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h₀ t :=
    heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds (U := Iio (1:ℝ))
      (fun _ ht => Iio_mem_nhds (by linarith [ht.2]))
      (fun s hs => hg_eq_h₀ s hs.le)
  have heq_1pδ_3 : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ),
      g t = h₁ t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h₁ t :=
    heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds (U := Ioo (1:ℝ) 3)
      (fun _ ht => Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith [ht.1]) ht.2)
      (fun s hs => hg_eq_h₁ s hs.1 hs.2)
  have heq_34 : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (3:ℝ) 4, g t = h₂ t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h₂ t :=
    heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds (U := Ioo (3:ℝ) 4)
      (fun _ ht => Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
      (fun s hs => hg_eq_h₂ s hs.1 hs.2.le)
  have heq_45 : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (4:ℝ) 5, g t = h₃ t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h₃ t :=
    heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds (U := Ioi (4:ℝ))
      (fun _ ht => Ioi_mem_nhds ht.1) (fun s hs => hg_eq_h₃ s hs)
  have hh₀_cont : ContinuousOn h₀ (Icc 0 (1 - δ_L)) :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₀ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hh₁_cont : ContinuousOn h₁ (Icc (1 + δ_R) 3) :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₁ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hh₂_cont : ContinuousOn h₂ (Icc 3 4) :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₂ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hh₃_cont : ContinuousOn h₃ (Icc 4 5) :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₃ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hh₀_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) (1 - δ_L), DifferentiableAt ℝ h₀ t :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₀ t).differentiableAt
  have hh₁_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ t :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₁ t).differentiableAt
  have hh₂_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (3:ℝ) 4, DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ t :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₂ t).differentiableAt
  have hh₃_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (4:ℝ) 5, DifferentiableAt ℝ h₃ t :=
    fun t _ => (hd_h₃ t).differentiableAt
  have hh₀_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h₀) (Icc 0 (1 - δ_L)) :=
    continuousOn_deriv_of_const _ hd_h₀ 0 (1 - δ_L)
  have hh₁_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h₁) (Icc (1 + δ_R) 3) :=
    continuousOn_deriv_of_arc_form hd_h₁ (1 + δ_R) 3
  have hh₂_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h₂) (Icc 3 4) :=
    continuousOn_deriv_of_const _ hd_h₂ 3 4
  have hh₃_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h₃) (Icc 4 5) :=
    continuousOn_deriv_of_const _ hd_h₃ 4 5
  have hh₀_slit : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) (1 - δ_L), h₀ t ∈ slitPlane := fun t ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₀ t (by linarith)]
    exact g_rho'_slitPlane hH ⟨ht0, by linarith⟩ (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have piece₀ := ftc_log_pieceFM (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - δ_L) hh₀_cont hh₀_diff
    hh₀_deriv_cont hh₀_slit heq_0_1mδ hg0 hg1mδ
  have hg_eq_h₁_on : ∀ t ∈ Icc (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ), g t = h₁ t := fun t ⟨_, ht3⟩ => by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht3 with rfl | ht3'
    · exact hg3_1
    · exact hg_eq_h₁ t (by linarith) ht3'
  obtain ⟨hg_im_nn_arc_R, hg_ne_arc_R, hg_slit_arc_R⟩ := g_rho'_arc_right_triple H hH hδ_R
  have hh₁_im_nn : ∀ t ∈ Icc (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ), 0 ≤ (h₁ t).im := fun t ht => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₁_on t ht]; exact hg_im_nn_arc_R t ht
  have hh₁_ne : ∀ t ∈ Icc (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ), h₁ t ≠ 0 := fun t ht => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₁_on t ht]; exact hg_ne_arc_R t ht
  have hh₁_slit_interior : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (1 + δ_R) (3:ℝ), h₁ t ∈ slitPlane := fun t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩ => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₁ t (by linarith) ht3]; exact hg_slit_arc_R t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩
  have piece₁ := ftc_log_piece_upper (by linarith : (1 + δ_R) ≤ 3) hh₁_cont hh₁_diff
    hh₁_deriv_cont hh₁_im_nn hh₁_ne hh₁_slit_interior
    heq_1pδ_3 hg1pδ (hg3_2.symm ▸ hg3_1)
  have hg_eq_h₂_on : ∀ t ∈ Icc (3:ℝ) 4, g t = h₂ t := fun t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩ => by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht3 with rfl | ht3'
    · exact hg3_2
    · exact hg_eq_h₂ t ht3' ht4
  obtain ⟨hg_im_nn_seg3, hg_ne_seg3, hg_slit_seg3⟩ := g_rho'_seg3_triple H hH
  have hh₂_im_nn : ∀ t ∈ Icc (3:ℝ) 4, 0 ≤ (h₂ t).im := fun t ht => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₂_on t ht]; exact hg_im_nn_seg3 t ht
  have hh₂_ne : ∀ t ∈ Icc (3:ℝ) 4, h₂ t ≠ 0 := fun t ht => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₂_on t ht]; exact hg_ne_seg3 t ht
  have hh₂_slit_interior : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (3:ℝ) 4, h₂ t ∈ slitPlane := fun t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩ => by
    rw [← hg_eq_h₂ t ht3 ht4.le]; exact hg_slit_seg3 t ⟨ht3, ht4⟩
  have piece₂ := ftc_log_piece_upper (by norm_num : (3:ℝ) ≤ 4) hh₂_cont hh₂_diff
    hh₂_deriv_cont hh₂_im_nn hh₂_ne hh₂_slit_interior heq_34 hg3_2 (hg4_3.symm ▸ hg4_2)
  have hg_slit_seg4 := g_rho'_seg4_slit H hH
  have hh₃_slit : ∀ t ∈ Icc (4:ℝ) 5, h₃ t ∈ slitPlane := fun t ⟨ht4, ht5⟩ => by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht4 with rfl | ht4'
    · rw [← hg4_3]; exact hg_slit_seg4 4 ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩
    · rw [← hg_eq_h₃ t ht4']; exact hg_slit_seg4 t ⟨ht4'.le, ht5⟩
  have piece₃ := ftc_log_pieceFM (by norm_num : (4:ℝ) ≤ 5)
    hh₃_cont hh₃_diff hh₃_deriv_cont hh₃_slit heq_45 hg4_3 hg5
  refine ⟨piece₀.1, piece₁.1.trans (piece₂.1.trans piece₃.1), ?_⟩
  rw [(intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals piece₁.1
      (piece₂.1.trans piece₃.1)).symm,
    (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals piece₂.1 piece₃.1).symm,
    piece₀.2, piece₁.2, piece₂.2, piece₃.2]
  have hg_closed : g 0 = g 5 := fdBoundary_H_sub_closed H ρ'
  rw [hg_closed]; ring

name: norm_le_middle_rho_plus_one
statement:
private lemma norm_le_middle_rho_plus_one (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H)
    {ε δ_L δ_R : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hδ_L_pos : 0 < δ_L) (hδ_L_lt_one : δ_L < 1)
    (hδ_R_pos : 0 < δ_R) (hδ_R_lt_one : δ_R < 1)
    (h_norm_L : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ_L) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε)
    (h_norm_R : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_R) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε) :
    ∀ t, 1 - δ_L ≤ t → t ≤ 1 + δ_R →
      ¬(‖fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)‖ > ε)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht_lo ht_hi
  push Not
  have hpi_pos := Real.pi_pos
  have hH_gap : 0 < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by linarith
  rcases le_or_gt t 1 with ht1 | ht1
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht1 with rfl | ht1'
    · simp only [fdBoundary_H_at_one_eq_rho_plus_one, sub_self, norm_zero]
      exact hε.le
    · rw [g_rho'_norm_seg0 hH ht1',
          ← h_norm_L, g_rho'_norm_seg0_at hH hδ_L_pos]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hH_gap.le
  · rw [g_rho'_norm_arc_full ht1 (by linarith : t < 3),
        ← h_norm_R, g_rho'_norm_arc hδ_R_pos (by linarith : δ_R < 2)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
        (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith [show t - 1 ≤ δ_R by linarith]))
      (by norm_num)

name: rho'_norm_gt_right_of_arc
statement:
private lemma rho'_norm_gt_right_of_arc (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H)
    {ε δ_R : ℝ} (hε_lt_one : ε < 1) (hε_lt_gap : ε < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)
    (hδ_R_pos : 0 < δ_R) (hδ_R_lt_one : δ_R < 1)
    (h_norm_R : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_R) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo (1 + δ_R) (5 : ℝ),
      ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)‖ > ε
proof:
:= by
  intro t ⟨ht1, ht5⟩
  rcases le_or_gt t 3 with ht3 | ht3
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht3 with rfl | ht3'
    · calc ε < 1 := hε_lt_one
        _ ≤ _ := g_rho'_norm_ge_one_seg3 (le_refl 3) (by norm_num)
    · rw [g_rho'_norm_arc_full (by linarith : 1 < t) ht3',
          ← h_norm_R, g_rho'_norm_arc hδ_R_pos (by linarith : δ_R < 2)]
      have hpi_pos := Real.pi_pos
      apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)
      exact Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two
        (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
        (by nlinarith [show δ_R < t - 1 by linarith])
  · rcases le_or_gt t 4 with ht4 | ht4
    · calc ε < 1 := hε_lt_one
        _ ≤ _ := g_rho'_norm_ge_one_seg3 ht3.le ht4
    · calc ε < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := hε_lt_gap
        _ ≤ _ := g_rho'_norm_ge_seg4 hH ht4.le ht5.le

name: arc_angle_lt_epsilon
statement:
private lemma arc_angle_lt_epsilon {δ_R ε : ℝ} (hδ_R_pos : 0 < δ_R)
    (hδ_R_lt_one : δ_R < 1)
    (h_norm_R : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_R) - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)‖ = ε) :
    δ_R * Real.pi / 12 < ε
proof:
:=
  delta_pi_div_twelve_lt_eps hδ_R_pos hδ_R_lt_one.le
    (by linarith [h_norm_R ▸ g_rho'_norm_arc (H := H) hδ_R_pos (by linarith : δ_R < 2)])

name: rho'_pv_setup
statement:
private lemma rho'_pv_setup (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε_pos : 0 < ε)
    (hε_lt : ε < min (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12))) :
    let δ_L : ℝ
proof:
:= ε / (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)
    let δ_R : ℝ := 12 / Real.pi * Real.arcsin (ε / 2)
    ε < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 ∧ ε < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12) ∧
    -1 ≤ ε / 2 ∧ ε / 2 ≤ 1 ∧
    0 < δ_L ∧ δ_L < 1 ∧ 0 < δ_R ∧ δ_R < 1 ∧
    δ_R * Real.pi / 12 = Real.arcsin (ε / 2) ∧
    ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ_L) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε ∧
    ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_R) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε := by
  have hH_gap : 0 < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by linarith
  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hε_lt_gap : ε < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_lt_2sin : ε < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12) := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)
  have hε_half_neg : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ ε / 2 := by linarith
  have hε_half_le : ε / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [Real.sin_le_one (Real.pi / 12)]
  intro δ_L δ_R
  have hδL_pos : 0 < δ_L := div_pos hε_pos hH_gap
  have hδL_lt_one : δ_L < 1 := by
    show ε / (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) < 1; rwa [div_lt_one hH_gap]
  have hδR_pos : 0 < δ_R :=
    mul_pos (div_pos (by norm_num) hpi_pos) (Real.arcsin_pos.mpr (by linarith))
  have hδR_lt_one : δ_R < 1 := δ_right_lt_one_aux hε_half_neg hε_lt_2sin
  have hδR_angle : δ_R * Real.pi / 12 = Real.arcsin (ε / 2) := by
    show 12 / Real.pi * Real.arcsin (ε / 2) * Real.pi / 12 = Real.arcsin (ε / 2); field_simp
  have h_norm_L : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ_L) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε := by
    rw [g_rho'_norm_seg0_at hH hδL_pos]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ ε hH_gap.ne'
  have h_norm_R : ‖fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_R) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ = ε := by
    rw [g_rho'_norm_arc hδR_pos (by linarith : δ_R < 2), hδR_angle,
        Real.sin_arcsin hε_half_neg hε_half_le]
    linarith
  exact ⟨hε_lt_gap, hε_lt_2sin, hε_half_neg, hε_half_le,
    hδL_pos, hδL_lt_one, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, hδR_angle, h_norm_L, h_norm_R⟩

name: pv_integral_at_rho_plus_one_tendsto
statement:
theorem pv_integral_at_rho_plus_one_tendsto (H : ℝ) (hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) :
    Tendsto (fun ε => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..5, if ‖fdBoundary_H H t - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne‖ > ε
      then (fdBoundary_H H t - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne)⁻¹ *
           deriv (fun s => fdBoundary_H H s - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne) t
      else 0) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (-(I * ↑Real.pi / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  have hH_gap : 0 < H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by linarith
  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h2sin_pos := two_sin_pi_div_twelve_pos
  have hderiv_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun s => fdBoundary_H H s - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)) t =
      deriv (fdBoundary_H H) t := fun t => deriv_sub_const (f := fdBoundary_H H) _
  simp_rw [hderiv_eq]
  set threshold := min (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12)) with hthresh_def
  have hthresh_pos : 0 < threshold := lt_min hH_gap h2sin_pos
  set δ_left : ℝ → ℝ := fun ε => ε / (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) with hδL_def
  set δ_right : ℝ → ℝ := fun ε => 12 / Real.pi * Real.arcsin (ε / 2) with hδR_def
  set E : ℝ → ℂ := fun ε =>
    Complex.log (fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ_left ε) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne) -
    Complex.log (fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_right ε) - ellipticPointRhoPlusOne) with hE_def
  apply ContourIntegral.pv_tendsto_of_crossing_limit_asymmetric
      (γ := fdBoundary_H H) (s := ellipticPointRhoPlusOne) (a := 0) (b := 5) (t₀ := 1)
      (δ_left := δ_left) (δ_right := δ_right) (threshold := threshold) (E := E)
  · norm_num
  · exact hthresh_pos
  · exact fun ε hε_pos _ => div_pos hε_pos hH_gap
  · intro ε hε_pos _
    exact mul_pos (div_pos (by norm_num) hpi_pos) (Real.arcsin_pos.mpr (by linarith))
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
    simp only [hδL_def]
    norm_num
    rw [div_lt_one hH_gap]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
    have hε_half_neg : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ ε / 2 := by linarith
    have hε_lt_2sin : ε < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith [δ_right_lt_one_aux hε_half_neg hε_lt_2sin]
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt t ht_mem
    simp only [hδL_def] at ht_mem
    have ht_lt_one : t < 1 := by linarith [div_pos hε_pos hH_gap, ht_mem.2]
    rw [g_rho'_norm_seg0 hH ht_lt_one]
    calc ε = ε / (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) * (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) :=
              (div_mul_cancel₀ ε hH_gap.ne').symm
        _ < (1 - t) * (H - Real.sqrt 3 / 2) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith [ht_mem.2]) hH_gap
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt t ht_mem
    obtain ⟨hε_lt_gap, _, _, _, _, _, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, _, h_norm_R⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_pos hε_lt
    have hε_lt_one : ε < 1 := by
      have hsin_bound : Real.sin (Real.pi / 12) < 1 / 2 :=
        (Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
            (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])).trans_eq
          Real.sin_pi_div_six
      linarith [lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_right _ _)]
    simp only [hδR_def] at ht_mem
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht_mem.2 with rfl | ht_lt5
    · exact hε_lt_gap.trans_le (g_rho'_norm_ge_seg4 hH (by norm_num) le_rfl)
    · exact rho'_norm_gt_right_of_arc H hH hε_lt_one hε_lt_gap hδR_pos hδR_lt_one h_norm_R
        t ⟨ht_mem.1, ht_lt5⟩
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt t ht_mem
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hδL_pos, hδL_lt_one, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, h_norm_L, h_norm_R⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_pos hε_lt
    exact not_lt.mp (norm_le_middle_rho_plus_one H hH hε_pos hδL_pos hδL_lt_one
      hδR_pos hδR_lt_one h_norm_L h_norm_R t ht_mem.1 ht_mem.2)
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hδL_pos, hδL_lt_one, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, _, _⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_pos hε_lt
    simp only [hE_def, hδL_def, hδR_def]
    simp_rw [inv_mul_deriv_eq_logDeriv_sub H ellipticPointRhoPlusOne]
    exact (ftc_logDeriv_telescope_rho_plus_one H hH hδL_pos hδL_lt_one hδR_pos hδR_lt_one).2.2
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hδL_pos, hδL_lt_one, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, _, _⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_pos hε_lt
    rw [inv_mul_deriv_eq_logDeriv_sub H ellipticPointRhoPlusOne]
    exact (ftc_logDeriv_telescope_rho_plus_one H hH hδL_pos hδL_lt_one hδR_pos hδR_lt_one).1
  · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hδL_pos, hδL_lt_one, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, _, _⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_pos hε_lt
    rw [inv_mul_deriv_eq_logDeriv_sub H ellipticPointRhoPlusOne]
    exact (ftc_logDeriv_telescope_rho_plus_one H hH hδL_pos hδL_lt_one hδR_pos hδR_lt_one).2.1
  · rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro r hr
    refine ⟨min threshold r, lt_min hthresh_pos hr, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε_mem hε_dist
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hε_mem
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hε_mem] at hε_dist
    have hε_lt : ε < threshold := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_dist (min_le_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hδL_pos, _, hδR_pos, hδR_lt_one, _, h_norm_L, h_norm_R⟩ :=
      rho'_pv_setup H hH hε_mem hε_lt
    simp only [hE_def]
    set zL := fdBoundary_H H (1 - δ_left ε) - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)
    set zR := fdBoundary_H H (1 + δ_right ε) - (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ)
    rw [Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.re_add_im (Complex.log zL),
      ← Complex.re_add_im (Complex.log zR), Complex.log_re, Complex.log_re,
      Complex.log_im, Complex.log_im, show ‖zL‖ = ε from h_norm_L,
      show ‖zR‖ = ε from h_norm_R, arg_approach_rho'_left hH hδL_pos,
      arg_approach_rho'_right_helper hδR_pos (by linarith : δ_right ε < 2),
      show ↑(Real.log ε) + ↑(Real.pi / 2) * I -
        (↑(Real.log ε) + ↑(5 * Real.pi / 6 + δ_right ε * Real.pi / 12) * I) -
        -(I * ↑Real.pi / 3) = ↑(-(δ_right ε * Real.pi / 12)) * I from by push_cast; ring,
      norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    exact lt_trans (arc_angle_lt_epsilon hδR_pos hδR_lt_one h_norm_R)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hε_dist (min_le_right _ _))

name: fdBoundary_H_at_one_eq_rho_plus_one
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_at_one_eq_rho_plus_one (H : ℝ) :
    fdBoundary_H H 1 = ellipticPointRhoPlusOne
proof:
:= by
  simp [fdBoundary_H, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']

name: fdBoundary_H_at_two_eq_I
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_at_two_eq_I (H : ℝ) :
    fdBoundary_H H 2 = I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, show ¬((2 : ℝ) ≤ 1) by norm_num, le_refl, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [show ((↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3 + (↑(2:ℝ) - 1) *
      (↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2 - ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3)) * I = ↑(Real.pi / 2) * I) by push_cast; ring,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
  push_cast; ring

name: fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_at_three_eq_rho (H : ℝ) :
    fdBoundary_H H 3 = ellipticPointRho
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, show ¬((3 : ℝ) ≤ 1) by norm_num,
    show ¬((3 : ℝ) ≤ 2) by norm_num, le_refl, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [show ((↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2 + (↑(3:ℝ) - 2) *
      (2 * ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3 - ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2)) * I = ↑(2 * Real.pi / 3) * I) by
    push_cast; ring,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, cos_two_pi_div_three, sin_two_pi_div_three]
  simp only [ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho', UpperHalfPlane.coe_mk]
  push_cast; ring

name: fdBoundary_H_seg1
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_seg1 (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = 1/2 + (↑H - ↑t * (↑H - ↑(Real.sqrt 3) / 2)) * I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, ht, ↓reduceIte]

name: fdBoundary_H_seg2
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_seg2 (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht1 : ¬(t ≤ 1)) (ht2 : t ≤ 2) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = exp ((↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3 + (↑t - 1) *
      (↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2 - ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3)) * I)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, ht1, ht2, ↓reduceIte]

name: fdBoundary_H_seg3
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_seg3 (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht1 : ¬(t ≤ 1)) (ht2 : ¬(t ≤ 2))
    (ht3 : t ≤ 3) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = exp ((↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2 + (↑t - 2) *
      (2 * ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 3 - ↑(Real.pi : ℝ) / 2)) * I)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, ht1, ht2, ht3, ↓reduceIte]

name: fdBoundary_H_seg4
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_seg4 (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht1 : ¬(t ≤ 1)) (ht2 : ¬(t ≤ 2))
    (ht3 : ¬(t ≤ 3)) (ht4 : t ≤ 4) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = -1/2 + (↑(Real.sqrt 3) / 2 + (↑t - 3) *
      (↑H - ↑(Real.sqrt 3) / 2)) * I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, ht1, ht2, ht3, ht4, ↓reduceIte]

name: fdBoundary_H_seg5
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_seg5 (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht1 : ¬(t ≤ 1)) (ht2 : ¬(t ≤ 2))
    (ht3 : ¬(t ≤ 3)) (ht4 : ¬(t ≤ 4)) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = (↑t - 9/2) + ↑H * I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, ht1, ht2, ht3, ht4, ↓reduceIte]

name: fdBoundary_H_eq_arc
statement:
theorem fdBoundary_H_eq_arc {H : ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht1 : 1 < t) (ht3 : t < 3) :
    fdBoundary_H H t = Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdBoundary_H, show ¬(t ≤ 1) by linarith, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases h2 : t ≤ 2 <;>
    simp only [h2, ↓reduceIte, ht3.le] <;>
    congr 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: ftc_log_pieceFM
statement:
lemma ftc_log_pieceFM {g h : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hh_cont : ContinuousOn h (Icc a b)) (hh_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ h t)
    (hh_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h) (Icc a b))
    (hh_slit : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, h t ∈ Complex.slitPlane)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, g t = h t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h t)
    (heq_a : g a = h a) (heq_b : g b = h b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume a b ∧
    ∫ t in a..b, deriv g t / g t = Complex.log (g b) - Complex.log (g a)
proof:
:=
  LogDerivFTC.ftc_log_pieceFM hab hh_cont hh_diff hh_deriv_cont hh_slit heq heq_a heq_b

name: continuousOn_arg_im_nonneg
statement:
lemma continuousOn_arg_im_nonneg :
    ContinuousOn Complex.arg {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.im ∧ z ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  intro z ⟨hz_im, hz_ne⟩
  exact ContinuousWithinAt.congr
    ((continuous_re.continuousWithinAt.div continuous_norm.continuousWithinAt
      (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz_ne)).arccos)
    (fun w ⟨hw_im, hw_ne⟩ => Complex.arg_of_im_nonneg_of_ne_zero hw_im hw_ne)
    (Complex.arg_of_im_nonneg_of_ne_zero hz_im hz_ne)

name: continuousOn_clog_im_nonneg
statement:
lemma continuousOn_clog_im_nonneg :
    ContinuousOn Complex.log {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.im ∧ z ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  intro z ⟨hz_im, hz_ne⟩
  rw [show Complex.log = fun w => ↑(Real.log ‖w‖) + ↑(Complex.arg w) * I from funext fun _ => rfl]
  refine ContinuousWithinAt.add ?_ ?_
  · exact (continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.comp
      ((Real.continuousAt_log (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz_ne)).comp
        continuous_norm.continuousAt)).continuousWithinAt
  · exact (continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.comp_continuousWithinAt
      (continuousOn_arg_im_nonneg z ⟨hz_im, hz_ne⟩)).mul continuousWithinAt_const

name: ftc_log_piece_congr_aux
statement:
private lemma ftc_log_piece_congr_aux {g h : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, g t = h t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h t)
    (hint_h : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv h t / h t) volume a b) :
    (∀ᵐ t ∂volume, t ∈ Ι a b → deriv g t / g t = deriv h t / h t) ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume a b
proof:
:= by
  have hb_ae : ({b} : Set ℝ)ᶜ ∈ ae volume := by simp [mem_ae_iff]
  have h_congr : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume, t ∈ Ι a b → deriv g t / g t = deriv h t / h t := by
    filter_upwards [hb_ae] with t ht_ne_b ht_mem
    have ht_ne : t ≠ b := fun h => ht_ne_b (mem_singleton_iff.mpr h)
    rw [uIoc_of_le hab] at ht_mem
    obtain ⟨hval, hderiv⟩ := heq t ⟨ht_mem.1, lt_of_le_of_ne ht_mem.2 ht_ne⟩
    rw [hval, hderiv]
  refine ⟨h_congr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.congr
      (show Integrable _ (volume.restrict (Ioc a b)) from hint_h.1)
      ((MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr
        (h_congr.mono (fun t ht hm => (ht (uIoc_of_le hab ▸ hm)).symm)))
  · rw [show Ioc b a = ∅ from Set.Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.mpr hab)]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_empty

name: ftc_log_piece_upper
statement:
lemma ftc_log_piece_upper {g h : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hh_cont : ContinuousOn h (Icc a b)) (hh_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ h t)
    (hh_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h) (Icc a b))
    (hh_im_nn : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, 0 ≤ (h t).im) (hh_ne : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, h t ≠ 0)
    (hh_slit_interior : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, h t ∈ slitPlane)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, g t = h t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h t)
    (heq_a : g a = h a) (heq_b : g b = h b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume a b ∧
    ∫ t in a..b, deriv g t / g t = Complex.log (g b) - Complex.log (g a)
proof:
:= by
  have hh_log_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t => Complex.log (h t)) (Icc a b) :=
    ContinuousOn.comp continuousOn_clog_im_nonneg hh_cont
      (fun t ht => ⟨hh_im_nn t ht, hh_ne t ht⟩)
  have hint_h : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv h t / h t) volume a b :=
    ((hh_deriv_cont.div hh_cont hh_ne).mono (uIcc_of_le hab ▸ Subset.rfl)).intervalIntegrable
  obtain ⟨h_congr, hint_g⟩ := ftc_log_piece_congr_aux hab heq hint_h
  have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hab
    hh_log_cont (fun t ht => (hh_diff t ht).hasDerivAt.clog_real
      (hh_slit_interior t ht)) hint_h
  exact ⟨hint_g, by
    calc ∫ t in a..b, deriv g t / g t
        = ∫ t in a..b, deriv h t / h t := intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae h_congr
      _ = Complex.log (h b) - Complex.log (h a) := h_ftc
      _ = Complex.log (g b) - Complex.log (g a) := by rw [heq_a, heq_b]⟩

name: ftc_log_piece_lower
statement:
lemma ftc_log_piece_lower {g h : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hh_cont : ContinuousOn h (Icc a b)) (hh_diff : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ h t)
    (hh_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv h) (Icc a b))
    (hh_im_np : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, (h t).im ≤ 0) (hh_ne : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, h t ≠ 0)
    (hh_im_neg_interior : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, (h t).im < 0)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, g t = h t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h t)
    (heq_a : g a = h a) (heq_b : g b = h b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv g t / g t) volume a b ∧
    ∫ t in a..b, deriv g t / g t =
      Complex.log (-(g b)) - Complex.log (-(g a))
proof:
:= by
  have hnh_log_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t => Complex.log (-(h t))) (Icc a b) :=
    ContinuousOn.comp continuousOn_clog_im_nonneg hh_cont.neg fun t ht =>
      ⟨by simpa using hh_im_np t ht, neg_ne_zero.mpr (hh_ne t ht)⟩
  have hint_h : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => deriv h t / h t) volume a b :=
    ((hh_deriv_cont.div hh_cont hh_ne).mono (uIcc_of_le hab ▸ Subset.rfl)).intervalIntegrable
  obtain ⟨h_congr, hint_g⟩ := ftc_log_piece_congr_aux hab heq hint_h
  have hnh_slit : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, (-(h t)) ∈ slitPlane := fun t ht => by
    rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
    exact Or.inr (by simpa using ne_of_lt (hh_im_neg_interior t ht))
  have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hab
    hnh_log_cont (fun t ht => by
      have := (hh_diff t ht).hasDerivAt.neg.clog_real (hnh_slit t ht)
      exact (show -deriv h t / -h t = deriv h t / h t by simp only [neg_div_neg_eq]) ▸ this) hint_h
  exact ⟨hint_g, by
    calc ∫ t in a..b, deriv g t / g t
        = ∫ t in a..b, deriv h t / h t := intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae h_congr
      _ = Complex.log (-(h b)) - Complex.log (-(h a)) := h_ftc
      _ = Complex.log (-(g b)) - Complex.log (-(g a)) := by rw [heq_a, heq_b]⟩

name: hasDerivAt_arc_sub_const
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_arc_sub_const (s : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I) - s)
      (↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.pi * (1 + s) / 6) (Real.pi / 6) t :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (1:ℝ) |>.const_mul (Real.pi / 6)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Eventually.of_forall fun s => by simp [id]; ring) |>.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hci : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (↑(Real.pi * (1 + s) / 6) : ℂ) * I)
      ((↑(Real.pi / 6) : ℂ) * I) t :=
    (hf.ofReal_comp.mul_const I).congr_deriv (by norm_num [smul_eq_mul])
  exact (hci.cexp.sub (hasDerivAt_const t s)).congr_deriv (by simp only [sub_zero]; ring)

name: fdBoundary_H_sub_closed

lemma fdBoundary_H_sub_closed (H : ℝ) (c : ℂ) :

name: continuous_arc_deriv
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_arc_deriv :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => (↑(Real.pi / 6) : ℂ) * I *
      Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I)
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop

name: continuousOn_deriv_of_arc_form
statement:
lemma continuousOn_deriv_of_arc_form {h : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h
      (↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I)) t)
    (a b : ℝ) : ContinuousOn (deriv h) (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show deriv h =
      fun t => ↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6) * I) from
    funext fun t => (hd t).deriv]

name: hasDerivAt_seg5_line
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_seg5_line (c : ℝ) (d : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (↑(s - c) : ℂ) + d) 1 t
proof:
:=
  (((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const c).ofReal_comp.add (hasDerivAt_const t d)).congr_deriv
    (by simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, add_zero])

name: hasDerivAt_aff_imI_neg
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_aff_imI_neg (k : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (↑((c - s) * k) : ℂ) * I) (-(↑k : ℂ) * I) t
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (c - s) * k) (-k) t :=
    (((hasDerivAt_const t c).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).mul_const k).congr_deriv (by ring)
  exact (h1.ofReal_comp.mul_const I).congr_deriv (by push_cast; ring)

name: hasDerivAt_aff_imI_pos
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_aff_imI_pos (k : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (↑((s - c) * k) : ℂ) * I) ((↑k : ℂ) * I) t
proof:
:=
  ((((hasDerivAt_id t).sub (hasDerivAt_const t c)).mul_const k).ofReal_comp.mul_const
    I).congr_deriv (by norm_num [smul_eq_mul])

name: hasDerivAt_aff_imI_pos_shift
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_aff_imI_pos_shift (d : ℂ) (k c0 : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => d + (↑(c0 + (s - c) * k) : ℂ) * I) ((↑k : ℂ) * I) t
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => c0 + (s - c) * k) k t :=
    ((((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const c).mul_const k).const_add c0).congr_deriv (by ring)
  exact ((hasDerivAt_const t d).add (hf.ofReal_comp.mul_const I)).congr_deriv (by ring)

name: continuousOn_deriv_of_const
statement:
lemma continuousOn_deriv_of_const {h : ℝ → ℂ} (c : ℂ) (hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt h c t)
    (a b : ℝ) : ContinuousOn (deriv h) (Icc a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show deriv h = fun _ => c from funext fun t => (hd t).deriv]; exact continuousOn_const

name: heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds
statement:
lemma heq_deriv_of_eq_on_nhds {g h : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ}
    {U : Set ℝ} (hU : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, U ∈ 𝓝 t)
    (hgh : ∀ s ∈ U, g s = h s) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, g t = h t ∧ deriv g t = deriv h t
proof:
:= fun t ht =>
  ⟨hgh t (mem_of_mem_nhds (hU t ht)), Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU t ht) (fun s hs => hgh s hs))⟩

name: inv_mul_deriv_eq_logDeriv_sub
statement:
lemma inv_mul_deriv_eq_logDeriv_sub (H : ℝ) (c : ℂ) :
    (fun t => (fdBoundary_H H t - c)⁻¹ * deriv (fdBoundary_H H) t) =
    (fun t => deriv (fun s => fdBoundary_H H s - c) t / (fdBoundary_H H t - c))
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  have : deriv (fun s => fdBoundary_H H s - c) t = deriv (fdBoundary_H H) t :=
    deriv_sub_const (f := fdBoundary_H H) c
  rw [this, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: arg_ofReal_mul_I
statement: lemma arg_ofReal_mul_I {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : ((↑r : ℂ) * I).arg = Real.pi / 2

lemma sin_delta_pi_div_twelve_pos {δ : ℝ} (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) (hδ_lt : δ < 2) :

name: norm_two_sin_mul_exp
statement:
lemma norm_two_sin_mul_exp {δ θ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ2 : δ < 2) :
    ‖(↑(2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑θ * I)‖ =
      2 * Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12)
proof:
:= by

    Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sin_delta_pi_div_twelve_pos hδ hδ2).le),

statement: lemma two_sin_pi_div_twelve_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12)

name: arcsin_half_lt_pi_div_twelve
statement:
lemma arcsin_half_lt_pi_div_twelve {ε : ℝ} (hε_half_neg : -1 ≤ ε / 2)
    (hε_lt_2sin : ε < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12)) :
    Real.arcsin (ε / 2) < Real.pi / 12
proof:
:=
  calc Real.arcsin (ε / 2)
      < Real.arcsin (Real.sin (Real.pi / 12)) :=
        Real.arcsin_lt_arcsin hε_half_neg (by linarith) (Real.sin_le_one _)
    _ = Real.pi / 12 :=
        Real.arcsin_sin (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])

name: delta_pi_div_twelve_lt_eps
statement:
lemma delta_pi_div_twelve_lt_eps {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) (hδ_le_one : δ ≤ 1)
    (h_sin_eq : Real.sin (δ * Real.pi / 12) = ε / 2) :
    δ * Real.pi / 12 < ε
proof:
:= by
  set x := δ * Real.pi / 12 with hx_def
  have hx_pos : 0 < x := by positivity
  have hx_le_one : x ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_le_four]
  nlinarith [Real.sin_gt_sub_cube hx_pos hx_le_one, sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg (1 - x)]

name: twelve_div_pi_arcsin_half_lt_one
statement:
lemma twelve_div_pi_arcsin_half_lt_one {ε : ℝ} (hε_half_neg : -1 ≤ ε / 2)
    (hε_lt_2sin : ε < 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 12)) :
    12 / Real.pi * Real.arcsin (ε / 2) < 1
proof:
:=
  calc 12 / Real.pi * Real.arcsin (ε / 2)
      < 12 / Real.pi * (Real.pi / 12) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (arcsin_half_lt_pi_div_twelve hε_half_neg hε_lt_2sin)
          (div_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)
    _ = 1 := by field_simp

name: deriv_fdBoundary_H_arc
statement:
private lemma deriv_fdBoundary_H_arc (H : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (h1 : 1 < t) (h3 : t < 3) :
    deriv (fdBoundary_H H) t = ↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * fdBoundary_H H t
proof:
:= by
  rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc h1 h3]
  erw [(fdBoundary_H_hasDerivAt_arc H h1 h3).deriv]
  push_cast
  ring

name: logDeriv_modform_S_transform
statement:
lemma logDeriv_modform_S_transform (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (hz_ne : z ≠ 0)
    (hgz : modularFormCompOfComplex f z ≠ 0) :
    logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f) z =
    logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f) (-(1:ℂ)/z) / z ^ 2 - ↑k / z
proof:
:= by
  set g := modularFormCompOfComplex f
  have h_uhp_open : IsOpen {w : ℂ | 0 < w.im} := UpperHalfPlane.isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet
  have h_eq_nhd : (fun w => g (-(1:ℂ)/w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun w => w ^ k * g w) := by
    filter_upwards [h_uhp_open.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
    exact modform_comp_ofComplex_S_identity f w hw
  have h_neg_inv_im : 0 < (-(1:ℂ)/z).im := by
    rw [show -(1:ℂ)/z = (-z)⁻¹ by field_simp, Complex.inv_im]
    exact div_pos (by simp [hz]) (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr (neg_ne_zero.mpr hz_ne))
  have h_diffOn_g : DifferentiableOn ℂ g {w | 0 < w.im} :=
    UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiable_iff.mp f.holo'
  have h_logDeriv_comp : logDeriv (fun w => g (-(1:ℂ)/w)) z =
      logDeriv g (-(1:ℂ)/z) * deriv (fun w => -(1:ℂ)/w) z :=
    logDeriv_comp (h_diffOn_g.differentiableAt (h_uhp_open.mem_nhds h_neg_inv_im))
      (DifferentiableAt.div (differentiableAt_const _) differentiableAt_id hz_ne)
  have h_deriv_S : deriv (fun w => -(1:ℂ)/w) z = 1 / z ^ 2 := by
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => -(1:ℂ) / w) (1 / z ^ 2) z := by
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => -w⁻¹) (-(-(z ^ 2)⁻¹)) z := (hasDerivAt_inv hz_ne).neg
      convert h3 using 1 <;> [ext w; skip] <;> field_simp
    exact h2.deriv
  have h_logDeriv_mul : logDeriv (fun w => w ^ k * g w) z =
      logDeriv (· ^ k) z + logDeriv g z :=
    logDeriv_mul z (zpow_ne_zero k hz_ne) hgz (differentiableAt_zpow.mpr (.inl hz_ne))
      (h_diffOn_g.differentiableAt (h_uhp_open.mem_nhds hz))
  have h_logDeriv_eq : logDeriv (fun w => g (-(1:ℂ)/w)) z =
      logDeriv (fun w => w ^ k * g w) z := by
    simp only [logDeriv_apply]
    rw [h_eq_nhd.eq_of_nhds, h_eq_nhd.deriv.eq_of_nhds]
  rw [h_logDeriv_eq, h_logDeriv_mul, logDeriv_zpow z k, h_deriv_S] at h_logDeriv_comp
  linear_combination h_logDeriv_comp

name: S_isometry_unit_circle
statement:
lemma S_isometry_unit_circle (z w : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) :
    ‖-(1:ℂ)/z - (-(1:ℂ)/w)‖ = ‖z - w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hzne : z ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hz
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hw
  rw [show -(1:ℂ)/z - (-(1:ℂ)/w) = (z - w) / (z * w) by field_simp; ring,
      norm_div, norm_mul, hz, hw]
  norm_num

name: fdBoundary_arc_S_reverse
statement:
lemma fdBoundary_arc_S_reverse (H : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3) :
    fdBoundary_H H (4 - t) = -(1:ℂ) / fdBoundary_H H t
proof:
:= by
  rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc (by linarith [ht.2]) (by linarith [ht.1]),
      fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht.1 ht.2, eq_div_iff (Complex.exp_ne_zero _), ← Complex.exp_add]
  convert exp_pi_mul_I using 2
  push_cast
  ring

name: arc_indicator_symmetric_of_sArcOfS
statement:
private lemma arc_indicator_symmetric_of_sArcOfS
    (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) (H ε : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3) :
    (∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H (4 - t) - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε) ↔
    (∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε)
proof:
:= by
  have h_S_unit := sArcOfS_unit S
  have h_S_closed := sArcOfS_closed S
  have h_arc_rev : fdBoundary_H H (4 - t) = -(1:ℂ) / fdBoundary_H H t :=
    fdBoundary_arc_S_reverse H t ht
  have h_norm_t : ‖fdBoundary_H H t‖ = 1 := by
    rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht.1 ht.2]
    exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s₀, hs₀, h_le⟩
    refine ⟨-(1:ℂ)/s₀, h_S_closed s₀ hs₀, ?_⟩
    have h_norm_s := h_S_unit s₀ hs₀
    calc ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (-(1:ℂ)/s₀)‖ = ‖-(1:ℂ)/fdBoundary_H H t - (-(1:ℂ)/(-(1:ℂ)/s₀))‖ :=
          (S_isometry_unit_circle _ _ h_norm_t (by rw [norm_div, norm_neg, norm_one, h_norm_s, div_one])).symm
      _ = ‖-(1:ℂ)/fdBoundary_H H t - s₀‖ := by
          have hne : s₀ ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at h_norm_s
          congr 2
          field_simp
      _ = ‖fdBoundary_H H (4 - t) - s₀‖ := by rw [← h_arc_rev]
      _ ≤ ε := h_le
  · rintro ⟨s₁, hs₁, h_le⟩
    refine ⟨-(1:ℂ)/s₁, h_S_closed s₁ hs₁, ?_⟩
    rw [h_arc_rev, S_isometry_unit_circle _ _ h_norm_t (h_S_unit s₁ hs₁)]
    exact h_le

name: cpv_integrand_intervalIntegrable_arc
statement:
private lemma cpv_integrand_intervalIntegrable_arc (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    (H : ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (h_oncurve : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3,
        modularFormCompOfComplex f (fdBoundary_H H t) = 0 →
        fdBoundary_H H t ∈ (↑(sArcOfS S) : Set ℂ)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => cpvIntegrandOn (↑(sArcOfS S))
        (logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f)) (fdBoundary_H H) ε t)
      volume 1 3
proof:
:= by
  set g := modularFormCompOfComplex f
  set γ := fdBoundary_H H
  set S_arc := sArcOfS S
  set F := fun t => cpvIntegrandOn (↑S_arc) (logDeriv g) γ ε t
  set K' := {t ∈ Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 3 | ∀ s ∈ S_arc, ε ≤ ‖γ t - (s : ℂ)‖}
  have hK'_compact : IsCompact K' := by
    refine IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset isCompact_Icc ?_ (fun _t ⟨ht, _⟩ => ht)
    refine IsClosed.inter isClosed_Icc ?_
    convert (isClosed_iInter fun s => isClosed_iInter fun _ =>
      isClosed_le (f := fun _ => ε) (g := fun t => ‖γ t - s‖) continuous_const (by fun_prop)
      : IsClosed (⋂ (s : ℂ) (_ : s ∈ S_arc), {t : ℝ | ε ≤ ‖γ t - s‖})) using 1
    ext t; simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_setOf]; exact Iff.rfl
  set K := {t ∈ Set.uIoc (1:ℝ) 3 | ¬∃ s ∈ (↑S_arc : Set ℂ), ‖γ t - s‖ ≤ ε}
  have hK_subset_K' : K ⊆ K' := fun t ⟨ht_uioc, h_not_near⟩ => by
    have ht_Ioc : t ∈ Set.Ioc 1 3 := by rwa [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num)] at ht_uioc
    refine ⟨⟨ht_Ioc.1.le, ht_Ioc.2⟩, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    by_contra! h_contra
    exact h_not_near ⟨s, Finset.mem_coe.mpr hs, h_contra.le⟩
  have h_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t => logDeriv g (γ t) * deriv γ t) K' := by
    intro t ⟨⟨ht1, ht3⟩, h_far⟩
    have ht_not_1 : t ≠ 1 := by
      rintro rfl
      have h1 := h_far _ (sArcOfS_rho_plus_one_in S)
      rw [show γ 1 = ellipticPointRhoPlusOne from fdBoundary_H_at_one H,
          sub_self, norm_zero] at h1; linarith
    have ht_not_3 : t ≠ 3 := by
      rintro rfl
      have h3 := h_far _ (sArcOfS_rho_in S)
      rw [show γ 3 = ellipticPointRho from fdBoundary_H_at_three H,
          sub_self, norm_zero] at h3; linarith
    have ht_ioo : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 :=
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 (Ne.symm ht_not_1), lt_of_le_of_ne ht3 ht_not_3⟩
    have h_ne : g (γ t) ≠ 0 := fun h_zero => by
      have h_dist := h_far _ (Finset.mem_coe.mp (h_oncurve t ht_ioo h_zero))
      rw [sub_self, norm_zero] at h_dist; linarith
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    refine ContinuousAt.mul ?_ ?_
    · refine ContinuousAt.comp ?_ (fdBoundary_H_continuous H).continuousAt
      have h_im : 0 < (γ t).im := by
        rw [show γ t = _ from fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht_ioo.1 ht_ioo.2,
            Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
        exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
          (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
      exact (analyticAt_logDeriv_off_zeros' f (γ t) h_im h_ne).continuousAt
    · have h_deriv_eq : deriv γ =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun s => ↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * γ s := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht_ioo.1 ht_ioo.2] with s hs
        exact deriv_fdBoundary_H_arc H hs.1 hs.2
      exact ((continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_const).mul
        (fdBoundary_H_continuous H).continuousAt).congr h_deriv_eq.symm
  have h_int : IntegrableOn (fun t => logDeriv g (γ t) * deriv γ t) K' :=
    ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK'_compact h_cont
  have hK_meas : MeasurableSet K := by
    apply measurableSet_uIoc.inter
    apply MeasurableSet.compl
    suffices h : IsClosed (⋃ s ∈ (↑S_arc : Set ℂ), {t : ℝ | ‖γ t - s‖ ≤ ε}) by
      convert h.measurableSet using 1
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf, Finset.mem_coe, exists_prop]
      exact Iff.rfl
    exact S_arc.finite_toSet.isClosed_biUnion fun s _ =>
      isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hF_K : EqOn F (fun t => logDeriv g (γ t) * deriv γ t) K := by
    intro t ⟨_, h_not_near⟩
    change cpvIntegrandOn (↑S_arc) (logDeriv g) γ ε t = _
    simp only [cpvIntegrandOn]
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe] at h_not_near
    exact if_neg h_not_near
  have h_int_K : IntegrableOn F K :=
    (IntegrableOn.mono_set h_int hK_subset_K').congr_fun hF_K.symm hK_meas
  have h_compl_zero : EqOn F 0 (Set.uIoc (1:ℝ) 3 \ K) := by
    intro t ⟨ht_uioc, h_not_K⟩
    change cpvIntegrandOn (↑S_arc) (logDeriv g) γ ε t = 0
    simp only [cpvIntegrandOn]
    refine if_pos ?_
    by_contra h_far
    exact h_not_K ⟨ht_uioc, by simpa [Finset.mem_coe] using h_far⟩
  have hcompl_meas : MeasurableSet (Set.uIoc (1:ℝ) 3 \ K) :=
    measurableSet_uIoc.diff hK_meas
  have h_int_compl : IntegrableOn F (Set.uIoc (1:ℝ) 3 \ K) :=
    integrableOn_zero.congr_fun h_compl_zero.symm hcompl_meas
  have h_int_union : IntegrableOn F (Set.uIoc (1:ℝ) 3) := by
    have := h_int_K.union h_int_compl
    rwa [Set.union_diff_cancel (fun t ht => ht.1)] at this
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3)]
  rwa [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3)] at h_int_union

name: arc_preimage_subsingleton
statement:
private lemma arc_preimage_subsingleton (H : ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    Set.Subsingleton ({t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 | fdBoundary_H H t = s})
proof:
:= by
  intro t₁ ⟨ht₁, h₁⟩ t₂ ⟨ht₂, h₂⟩
  rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht₁.1 ht₁.2] at h₁
  rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht₂.1 ht₂.2] at h₂
  have h_re := congrArg Complex.re (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
  rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re] at h_re
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hθ₁ : Real.pi * (1 + t₁) / 6 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi :=
    ⟨by nlinarith [ht₁.1], by nlinarith [ht₁.2]⟩
  have hθ₂ : Real.pi * (1 + t₂) / 6 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi :=
    ⟨by nlinarith [ht₂.1], by nlinarith [ht₂.2]⟩
  linarith [mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpi)
    (show Real.pi * (1 + t₁) = Real.pi * (1 + t₂) from
      by linarith [Real.strictAntiOn_cos.injOn hθ₁ hθ₂ h_re])]

name: arc_min_dist_pos
proof:
:= by
  rcases (sArcOfS S).eq_empty_or_nonempty with h_empty | hne
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun s hs => absurd (h_empty ▸ hs) (Finset.notMem_empty s)⟩
  · obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, h_min⟩ := (sArcOfS S).exists_min_image (fun s => ‖fdBoundary_H H t - s‖) hne
    exact ⟨‖fdBoundary_H H t - s₀‖,
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h_eq => by
        rw [h_eq] at h_not_in
        exact h_not_in (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hs₀))),
      h_min⟩

name: arc_cpv_integral_S_identity
statement:
lemma arc_cpv_integral_S_identity (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    (H : ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (h_oncurve : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3,
        modularFormCompOfComplex f (fdBoundary_H H t) = 0 →
        fdBoundary_H H t ∈ (↑(sArcOfS S) : Set ℂ)) :
    (∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, cpvIntegrandOn (sArcOfS S)
        (logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f)) (fdBoundary_H H) ε t) =
    -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 12 * I)) *
      ↑(∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3,
        if (∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε)
        then (0:ℝ) else 1)
proof:
:= by
  set g := modularFormCompOfComplex f with hg_def
  set γ := fdBoundary_H H
  set S_arc := sArcOfS S
  set F := cpvIntegrandOn S_arc (logDeriv g) γ ε
  set ind := fun t => ∃ s ∈ S_arc, ‖γ t - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε
  have h_ind_1 : ind 1 :=
    ⟨_, sArcOfS_rho_plus_one_in S, by
      rw [show γ 1 = ellipticPointRhoPlusOne from fdBoundary_H_at_one H,
          sub_self, norm_zero]; linarith⟩
  have h_ind_3 : ind 3 :=
    ⟨_, sArcOfS_rho_in S, by
      rw [show γ 3 = ellipticPointRho from fdBoundary_H_at_three H,
          sub_self, norm_zero]; linarith⟩
  have h_cov : ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, F (4 - t) = ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, F t := by
    simpa only [show (4:ℝ) - 3 = 1 by norm_num, show (4:ℝ) - 1 = 3 by norm_num]
      using @intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left ℂ _ _ 1 3 F 4
  have h_ind_sym : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3, (ind (4 - t) ↔ ind t) :=
    fun t ht => arc_indicator_symmetric_of_sArcOfS S H ε t ht
  have h_arc_ne_zero : ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 → γ t ≠ 0 := fun t ht => by
    rw [show γ t = _ from fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht.1 ht.2]; exact exp_ne_zero _
  have h_arc_im_pos : ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 → 0 < (γ t).im := fun t ht => by
    rw [show γ t = _ from fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht.1 ht.2, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
    exact Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by nlinarith [ht.1, Real.pi_pos])
      (by nlinarith [ht.2, Real.pi_pos])
  have h_4mt_ioo : ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 → (4 - t) ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 :=
    fun t ht => ⟨by linarith [ht.2], by linarith [ht.1]⟩
  have h_deriv_arc : ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 →
      deriv γ t = ↑(Real.pi / 6) * I * γ t :=
    fun t ht => deriv_fdBoundary_H_arc H ht.1 ht.2
  have h_pw : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (1:ℝ) 3,
      F (4 - t) + F t = -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) *
        ↑(if ind t then (0:ℝ) else 1) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3)] at ht
    by_cases h_near : ind t
    · have h_F_t : F t = 0 := by
        show cpvIntegrandOn _ _ _ _ _ = 0
        rw [cpvIntegrandOn, if_pos h_near]
      have h_ind_4mt : ind (4 - t) := by
        by_cases h1 : 1 < t ∧ t < 3
        · exact (h_ind_sym t ⟨h1.1, h1.2⟩).mpr h_near
        · push Not at h1
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with rfl | h_lt
          · exact (show (4:ℝ) - 1 = 3 by norm_num) ▸ h_ind_3
          · have : t = 3 := le_antisymm ht.2 (h1 h_lt)
            subst this
            exact (show (4:ℝ) - 3 = 1 by norm_num) ▸ h_ind_1
      have h_F_4mt : F (4 - t) = 0 := by
        show cpvIntegrandOn _ _ _ _ _ = 0
        rw [cpvIntegrandOn, if_pos h_ind_4mt]
      rw [h_F_4mt, h_F_t]
      simp [h_near]
    · have ht_ioo : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 :=
        ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (fun h => h_near (h ▸ h_ind_1)),
         lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (fun h => h_near (h ▸ h_ind_3))⟩
      have h_not_ind_4mt : ¬ind (4 - t) := fun h => h_near ((h_ind_sym t ht_ioo).mp h)
      have h_F_t : F t = logDeriv g (γ t) * deriv γ t := by
        show cpvIntegrandOn _ _ _ _ _ = _
        unfold cpvIntegrandOn; rw [if_neg h_near]
      have h_F_4mt : F (4 - t) = logDeriv g (γ (4 - t)) * deriv γ (4 - t) := by
        show cpvIntegrandOn _ _ _ _ _ = _
        unfold cpvIntegrandOn; rw [if_neg h_not_ind_4mt]
      rw [h_F_4mt, h_F_t, if_neg h_near]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, mul_one]
      have h_rev : γ (4 - t) = -(1:ℂ) / γ t := fdBoundary_arc_S_reverse H t ht_ioo
      have h_d_4mt := h_deriv_arc (4-t) (h_4mt_ioo t ht_ioo)
      have hg_ne : g (γ t) ≠ 0 := fun h_zero => h_near
        ⟨γ t, by rw [← Finset.mem_coe]; exact h_oncurve t ht_ioo h_zero,
         by rw [sub_self, norm_zero]; linarith⟩
      have h_logD := logDeriv_modform_S_transform f (γ t) (h_arc_im_pos t ht_ioo)
        (h_arc_ne_zero t ht_ioo) hg_ne
      simp only [← hg_def] at h_logD
      rw [h_rev] at h_d_4mt ⊢
      rw [h_d_4mt, h_deriv_arc t ht_ioo, h_logD]
      field_simp [h_arc_ne_zero t ht_ioo]
      push_cast; ring
  have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable F volume 1 3 :=
    cpv_integrand_intervalIntegrable_arc f S H ε hε h_oncurve
  set I_val := ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, F t
  set m_val := ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, if ind t then (0:ℝ) else 1
  have h_sum_int : ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, (F (4 - t) + F t) =
      -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) * ↑m_val := by
    calc ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, (F (4 - t) + F t)
        = ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) *
            ↑(if ind t then (0:ℝ) else 1) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_congr h_pw
      _ = -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) *
            ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, (↑(if ind t then (0:ℝ) else 1) : ℂ) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
      _ = -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) * ↑m_val := by
          congr 1; exact intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal
  have h_cov_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => F (4 - t)) volume 1 3 := by
    convert (hF_int.comp_sub_left 4).symm using 2 <;> norm_num
  have h_2I : I_val + I_val = -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 6 * I)) * ↑m_val := by
    have h_split := intervalIntegral.integral_add h_cov_int hF_int
    rw [h_cov] at h_split
    exact h_split ▸ h_sum_int
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (two_ne_zero (α := ℂ))
  rw [show (2 : ℂ) * I_val = I_val + I_val by ring, h_2I]; ring

name: arc_non_excluded_measure_tendsto
statement:
lemma arc_non_excluded_measure_tendsto (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) (H : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun ε => ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3,
        if (∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε)
        then (0:ℝ) else 1)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2:ℝ) = ∫ _ in (1:ℝ)..3, (1:ℝ) by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]; norm_num]
  apply intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
  · refine Eventually.of_forall fun ε => Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    apply measurable_const.ite _ measurable_const
    have h : {a | ∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H a - s‖ ≤ ε} =
        ⋃ s ∈ (sArcOfS S : Finset ℂ), {a | ‖fdBoundary_H H a - s‖ ≤ ε} := by
      ext; simp [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rw [h]
    exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun s _ =>
      (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const).measurableSet
  · refine Eventually.of_forall fun ε => Eventually.of_forall fun t _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · exact intervalIntegrable_const
  · rw [ae_iff]
    apply measure_mono_null (t := (⋃ s ∈ (sArcOfS S : Finset ℂ),
            {t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 | fdBoundary_H H t = ↑s}) ∪ {3})
    · intro t ht
      push Not at ht
      obtain ⟨ht_mem, ht_not⟩ := ht
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3)] at ht_mem
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_sep_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      by_contra! h_not_in
      obtain ⟨h_pre, h_ne_3⟩ := h_not_in
      apply ht_not
      have ht_ioo : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3 :=
        ⟨ht_mem.1, lt_of_le_of_ne ht_mem.2 h_ne_3⟩
      have h_not_in_S : (fdBoundary_H H t : ℂ) ∉ (↑(sArcOfS S) : Set ℂ) :=
        fun h_mem => h_pre _ (Finset.mem_coe.mp h_mem) ht_ioo rfl
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le⟩ := arc_min_dist_pos S H h_not_in_S
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ_pos] with ε hε
      rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hε
      rw [if_neg]
      push Not
      exact fun s hs => (hε.2).trans_le (hδ_le s hs)
    · apply measure_union_null
      · exact ((sArcOfS S).finite_toSet.biUnion (fun s _ =>
            (arc_preimage_subsingleton H s).finite)).measure_zero _
      · exact Real.volume_singleton

name: arc_cpv_contribution_tendsto
statement:
theorem arc_cpv_contribution_tendsto (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    (H : ℝ) (h_oncurve : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3,
        modularFormCompOfComplex f (fdBoundary_H H t) = 0 →
        fdBoundary_H H t ∈ (↑(sArcOfS S) : Set ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun ε => ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, cpvIntegrandOn (sArcOfS S)
        (logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f)) (fdBoundary_H H) ε t)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * I * (k : ℂ) / 12)))
proof:
:= by
  set I_arc : ℝ → ℂ := fun ε => ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, cpvIntegrandOn (sArcOfS S)
      (logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f)) (fdBoundary_H H) ε t
  set m_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun ε => ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3,
      if (∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H t - (s : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε)
      then (0:ℝ) else 1
  set g_fun : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => -(↑k * (↑Real.pi / 12 * I)) * (↑x : ℂ)
  have h_id : I_arc =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)] (g_fun ∘ m_fun) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact arc_cpv_integral_S_identity f S H ε hε h_oncurve
  have h_g_cont : Tendsto g_fun (𝓝 2) (𝓝 (g_fun 2)) :=
    (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).continuousAt
  rw [show -(2 * ↑Real.pi * I * (↑k : ℂ) / 12) = g_fun 2 by simp only [g_fun]; push_cast; ring]
  exact Tendsto.congr' h_id.symm (h_g_cont.comp (arc_non_excluded_measure_tendsto S H))

name: arc_re_strictly_between
statement:
private lemma arc_re_strictly_between (H : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (1:ℝ) 3) :
    -1/2 < (fdBoundary_H H t).re ∧ (fdBoundary_H H t).re < 1/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [fdBoundary_H_eq_arc ht.1 ht.2, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hθ_lo : Real.pi / 3 < Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6 := by nlinarith [ht.1]
  have hθ_hi : Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6 < 2 * Real.pi / 3 := by nlinarith [ht.2]
  have hθ_Icc : Real.pi * (1 + t) / 6 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi :=
    ⟨by nlinarith [ht.1], by nlinarith [ht.2]⟩
  have hpi3_Icc : Real.pi / 3 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi :=
    ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  have h23_Icc : 2 * Real.pi / 3 ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi :=
    ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := Real.strictAntiOn_cos hθ_Icc h23_Icc hθ_hi
    have h2 : Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 3) = -1 / 2 := by
      rw [show 2 * Real.pi / 3 = Real.pi - Real.pi / 3 by ring,
          Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_three]; ring
    linarith
  · have h1 := Real.strictAntiOn_cos hpi3_Icc hθ_Icc hθ_lo
    rw [Real.cos_pi_div_three] at h1
    linarith

name: arc_ne_svert
statement:
private lemma arc_ne_svert (H : ℝ) (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    (s : ℂ) (hs_re : s.re = 1/2 ∨ s.re = -1/2) (hs_not : s ∉ sArcOfS S)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 3) :
    fdBoundary_H H t ≠ s
proof:
:= by
  intro h_eq
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht.1 with ht1 | rfl
  · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht.2 with ht3 | rfl
    · have := arc_re_strictly_between H t ⟨ht1, ht3⟩
      rw [h_eq] at this
      rcases hs_re with h | h <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
    · rw [fdBoundary_H_at_three H] at h_eq
      exact hs_not (h_eq ▸ sArcOfS_rho_in S)
  · rw [fdBoundary_H_at_one H] at h_eq
    exact hs_not (h_eq ▸ sArcOfS_rho_plus_one_in S)

name: arc_min_dist_pos_of_svert
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, ht₀_min⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
    (⟨1, le_refl _, by norm_num⟩ : (Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 3).Nonempty)
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t => ‖fdBoundary_H H t - s‖)).continuousOn
  exact ⟨‖fdBoundary_H H t₀ - s‖,
    norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (arc_ne_svert H S s hs_re hs_not t₀ ht₀)),
    fun t ht => ht₀_min ht⟩

name: arc_svert_combined_dist
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_all_in : ∀ s ∈ sVertOfS S, s ∈ sArcOfS S
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun s hs hs_not => absurd (h_all_in s hs) hs_not⟩
  · suffices key : ∀ (SV : Finset ℂ), (∀ s ∈ SV, s ∈ sVertOfS S → s ∉ sArcOfS S →
          ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 3, δ ≤ ‖fdBoundary_H H t - s‖) →
        ∃ δ > 0, ∀ s ∈ SV, s ∈ sVertOfS S → s ∉ sArcOfS S →
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 3, δ ≤ ‖fdBoundary_H H t - s‖ by
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_bound⟩ := key (sVertOfS S) fun s hs hs_v =>
        arc_min_dist_pos_of_svert H S s (sVertOfS_re S s hs_v)
      exact ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun s hs hs_not t ht => hδ_bound s hs hs hs_not t ht⟩
    intro SV
    induction SV using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun s hs => absurd hs (Finset.notMem_empty s)⟩
    | @insert a SV' _ha ih =>
      intro h_all
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_bound⟩ := ih (fun s hs =>
        h_all s (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hs))
      by_cases ha_need : a ∈ sVertOfS S ∧ a ∉ sArcOfS S
      · obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_bound⟩ :=
          h_all a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) ha_need.1 ha_need.2
        exact ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ₂_pos, fun s hs h_sv h_na t ht => by
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hs with rfl | h
          · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (hδ₂_bound t ht)
          · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hδ₁_bound s h h_sv h_na t ht)⟩
      · push Not at ha_need
        exact ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, fun s hs h_sv h_na t ht => by
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hs with rfl | h
          · exact absurd (ha_need h_sv) h_na
          · exact hδ₁_bound s h h_sv h_na t ht⟩

name: arc_cpv_eventually_eq_union
statement:
lemma arc_cpv_eventually_eq_union (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    (H : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ),
      ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, cpvIntegrandOn (sArcOfS S ∪ sVertOfS S)
          g (fdBoundary_H H) ε t =
      ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3, cpvIntegrandOn (sArcOfS S)
          g (fdBoundary_H H) ε t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, h_far⟩ := arc_svert_combined_dist H S
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hδ_pos)] with ε hε_lt
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro t ht
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 3)] at ht
  unfold cpvIntegrandOn
  by_cases h_sarc : ∃ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖fdBoundary_H H t - s‖ ≤ ε
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, hle⟩ := h_sarc
    rw [if_pos ⟨s, Finset.mem_union_left _ hs, hle⟩, if_pos ⟨s, hs, hle⟩]
  · refine (if_neg ?_).trans (if_neg h_sarc).symm
    rintro ⟨s, hs, hle⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hs with h_arc | h_vert
    · exact h_sarc ⟨s, h_arc, hle⟩
    · by_cases hs_arc : s ∈ sArcOfS S
      · exact h_sarc ⟨s, hs_arc, hle⟩
      · exact absurd hle (not_le.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (h_far s h_vert hs_arc t ht)))

name: tendsto_pvIntegral_arc_bridge
statement:
theorem tendsto_pvIntegral_arc_bridge (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane)
    {H : ℝ} (_hH : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H) (h_oncurve_arc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 3,
      modularFormCompOfComplex f (fdBoundary_H H t) = 0 →
      fdBoundary_H H t ∈ (↑(sArcOfS S) : Set ℂ)) :
    Tendsto (fun ε =>
      ∫ t in (1:ℝ)..3,
        pvIntegrand f (fdBoundary_H H) (sArcOfS S ∪ sVertOfS S) ε t)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (-(2 * ↑Real.pi * I * ((k : ℂ) / 12))))
proof:
:= by
  have h_tend := arc_cpv_contribution_tendsto f S H h_oncurve_arc
  rw [show -(2 * ↑Real.pi * I * (↑k : ℂ) / 12) =
      -(2 * ↑Real.pi * I * ((k : ℂ) / 12)) by ring] at h_tend
  exact h_tend.congr' ((arc_cpv_eventually_eq_union S H
    (logDeriv (modularFormCompOfComplex f))).mono fun _ h => h.symm)

name: sArcOfS_rho_in
statement:
lemma sArcOfS_rho_in (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ellipticPointRho ∈ sArcOfS S
proof:
:= by
  simp [sArcOfS]

name: sArcOfS_rho_plus_one_in
statement:
lemma sArcOfS_rho_plus_one_in (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ellipticPointRhoPlusOne ∈ sArcOfS S
proof:
:= by
  simp [sArcOfS]

name: sArcOfS_unit
statement:
lemma sArcOfS_unit (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∀ s ∈ sArcOfS S, ‖s‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  simp only [sArcOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨p, ⟨_, hp_norm⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨_, hp_norm⟩, rfl⟩⟩ | hs
  · exact hp_norm
  · rw [norm_div, norm_neg, norm_one, hp_norm, div_one]
  · rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact ellipticPointRho_norm
    · exact ellipticPointRhoPlusOne_norm

name: neg_inv_rho_eq_rho_plus_one
statement:
private lemma neg_inv_rho_eq_rho_plus_one :
    -(1 : ℂ) / ellipticPointRho = ellipticPointRhoPlusOne
proof:
:= by
  have hre : (ellipticPointRho : ℂ).re = -1/2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho']
  have him : (ellipticPointRho : ℂ).im = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho']
  have hre2 : (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ).re = 1/2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']
  have him2 : (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ).im = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']
  have hnormSq :
      -(1/2 : ℝ) * -(1/2) + Real.sqrt 3 / 2 * (Real.sqrt 3 / 2) = 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num)]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [neg_div, Complex.neg_re, Complex.div_re,
      Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.normSq_apply,
      hre, him, hre2, hnormSq]
    ring
  · simp only [neg_div, Complex.neg_im, Complex.div_im,
      Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.normSq_apply,
      hre, him, him2, hnormSq]
    ring

name: neg_inv_rho_plus_one_eq_rho
statement:
private lemma neg_inv_rho_plus_one_eq_rho :
    -(1 : ℂ) / ellipticPointRhoPlusOne = ellipticPointRho
proof:
:= by
  have hre : (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ).re = 1/2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']
  have him : (ellipticPointRhoPlusOne : ℂ).im = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRhoPlusOne, ellipticPointRhoPlusOne']
  have hre2 : (ellipticPointRho : ℂ).re = -1/2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho']
  have him2 : (ellipticPointRho : ℂ).im = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    simp [ellipticPointRho, ellipticPointRho']
  have hnormSq : (1/2 : ℝ) * (1/2) + Real.sqrt 3 / 2 * (Real.sqrt 3 / 2) = 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num)]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [neg_div, Complex.neg_re, Complex.div_re,
      Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.normSq_apply,
      hre, him, hre2, hnormSq]
    ring
  · simp only [neg_div, Complex.neg_im, Complex.div_im,
      Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.normSq_apply,
      hre, him, him2, hnormSq]
    ring

name: sArcOfS_closed
statement:
lemma sArcOfS_closed (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∀ s ∈ sArcOfS S, -(1 : ℂ) / s ∈ sArcOfS S
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  simp only [sArcOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ⊢
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩ | hs
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  · refine Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩)
    have : (↑p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hp.2]; norm_num)
    field_simp
  · rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr neg_inv_rho_eq_rho_plus_one)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl neg_inv_rho_plus_one_eq_rho)

name: sVertOfS_re
statement:
lemma sVertOfS_re (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∀ s ∈ sVertOfS S, s.re = 1/2 ∨ s.re = -1/2
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  simp only [sVertOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟨p, ⟨_, hp_re, _⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨_, hp_re, _⟩, rfl⟩⟩ |
    ⟨p, ⟨_, hp_re, _⟩, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨_, hp_re, _⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl hp_re
  · right
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, hp_re]
    norm_num
  · exact Or.inr hp_re
  · left
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, hp_re]
    norm_num

name: sVertOfS_pair_left
statement:
lemma sVertOfS_pair_left (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∀ s ∈ sVertOfS S, s.re = 1/2 → s - 1 ∈ sVertOfS S
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hre
  simp only [sVertOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter] at hs ⊢
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩))
  · exfalso
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, hp.2.1] at hre
    norm_num at hre
  · exfalso
    linarith [hp.2.1]
  · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩)
    ring

name: sVertOfS_pair_right
statement:
lemma sVertOfS_pair_right (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∀ s ∈ sVertOfS S, s.re = -1/2 → s + 1 ∈ sVertOfS S
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs hre
  simp only [sVertOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter] at hs ⊢
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  · exfalso
    linarith [hp.2.1]
  · refine Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩))
    ring
  · exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  · exfalso
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, hp.2.1] at hre
    norm_num at hre

name: exists_height_bound_S
statement:
theorem exists_height_bound_S (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) :
    ∃ H₁ : ℝ, Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < H₁ ∧ 1 < H₁ ∧ ∀ s ∈ S, (s : ℂ).im < H₁
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt3 : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 < 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3]
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h_empty | h_ne
  · exact ⟨2, hsqrt3, by norm_num, by simp [h_empty]⟩
  set M := S.sup' h_ne (fun s : ℍ => (s : ℂ).im)
  refine ⟨max 2 (M + 1), lt_of_lt_of_le hsqrt3 (le_max_left _ _),
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2) (le_max_left _ _), fun s hs => ?_⟩
  calc (s : ℂ).im ≤ M := Finset.le_sup' (fun s : ℍ => (↑s : ℂ).im) hs
    _ < M + 1 := by linarith
    _ ≤ max 2 (M + 1) := le_max_right _ _

name: sVertOfS_im_lt_height_bound
statement:
lemma sVertOfS_im_lt_height_bound (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) (s : ℂ)
    (hs : s ∈ sVertOfS S) (h_bound : ∀ p ∈ S, (p : ℂ).im < H₁) :
    s.im < H₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sVertOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨⟨p, ⟨hp_mem, _⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨hp_mem, _⟩, rfl⟩⟩ |
    ⟨p, ⟨hp_mem, _⟩, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨hp_mem, _⟩, rfl⟩ <;>
    first | exact h_bound p hp_mem | simpa using h_bound p hp_mem

name: sum_gWN_ord_eq_filter_zeros
statement:
theorem sum_gWN_ord_eq_filter_zeros (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) (g : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∑ s ∈ S, g (↑s : ℂ) * (orderOfVanishingAt' (⇑f) s : ℂ) =
    ∑ s ∈ S.filter (fun p => f p = 0),
      g (↑s : ℂ) * (orderOfVanishingAt' (⇑f) s : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · simp [orderOfVanishingAt'_eq_zero_of_ne_zero' f p h]

name: sArcOfS_im_pos
statement:
lemma sArcOfS_im_pos (S : Finset UpperHalfPlane) (s : ℂ) (hs : s ∈ sArcOfS S) :
    0 < s.im
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sArcOfS, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨⟨p, ⟨_, _⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨_, hp_norm⟩, rfl⟩⟩ | hs
  · exact p.2
