    Finsupp.smul_apply _ _ _, smul_eq_mul, prod_T_gen_pow_eq_two]

name: evalHom_injective_two
statement:
theorem evalHom_injective_two (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (evalHom 2 p)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q hPQ
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]; set R := P - Q with hR_def
  have hR : evalHom 2 p R = 0 := by simp [R, map_sub, hPQ]
  by_contra hR_ne
  obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_min⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image R.support
    (fun d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ ↦ d 1) (MvPolynomial.support_nonempty.mpr hR_ne)
  have hs_coeff : R.coeff s ≠ 0 := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hs_mem
  have h_zero : (evalHom 2 p R) (T_diag (ppowDiag 2 p ![s 1, s 0 + s 1])) = 0 := by rw [hR]; rfl
  rw [evalHom_apply_eq_sum_monomial] at h_zero
  have h_delta : ∀ d ∈ R.support,
      R.coeff d * (T_gen 2 p 0 ^ (d 0) * T_gen 2 p 1 ^ (d 1))
          (T_diag (ppowDiag 2 p ![s 1, s 0 + s 1])) =
      if d = s then R.coeff d else 0 := by
    intro d hd_mem
    rw [monomial_eval_kronecker p hp (d 0) (d 1) (s 0) (s 1) (hs_min d hd_mem)]
    by_cases hds : d = s
    · subst hds; simp
    · rw [if_neg hds, if_neg (fun ⟨h0, h1⟩ ↦ hds (by ext i; fin_cases i; exacts [h0, h1])),
        mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_delta, Finset.sum_ite_eq_of_mem' R.support s _ hs_mem] at h_zero
  exact hs_coeff h_zero

name: evalHomR_surjective
statement:
lemma evalHomR_surjective (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (h_surj : ∀ f ∈ R_p n p hp, f ∈ (evalHom n p).range) :
    Function.Surjective (evalHomR n p hp)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨f, hf⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h_surj f hf
  exact ⟨P, Subtype.ext hP⟩

name: evalHomR_injective
statement:
lemma evalHomR_injective (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (p : ℕ) (_hp : p.Prime)
    (h_inj : Function.Injective (evalHom n p)) :
    Function.Injective (evalHomR n p ‹_›)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q hPQ
  exact h_inj (Subtype.ext_iff.mp hPQ)

name: slTransvecG_mul
statement:
private lemma slTransvecG_mul {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : ℤ) :
    slTransvecG i j hij a * slTransvecG i j hij b = slTransvecG i j hij (a + b)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Matrix.transvection_mul_transvection_same i j hij a b)

name: slTransvecG_zero
statement:
private lemma slTransvecG_zero {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    slTransvecG i j hij 0 = 1
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Matrix.transvection_zero i j)

name: slTransvecG_mul_entry
statement:
private lemma slTransvecG_mul_entry {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ) (a b : Fin m) :
    (slTransvecG i j hij c * σ).1 a b =
    if a = i then σ.1 i b + c * σ.1 j b else σ.1 a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, slTransvecG]
  split_ifs with hai
  · subst hai; simp [Matrix.transvection, Matrix.add_mul]
  · simp [Matrix.transvection, Matrix.add_mul, hai]

name: slTransvecG_mul_right_entry
statement:
private lemma slTransvecG_mul_right_entry {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ) (a b : Fin m) :
    (σ * slTransvecG i j hij c).1 a b =
    if b = j then σ.1 a j + c * σ.1 a i else σ.1 a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, slTransvecG]
  split_ifs with hbj
  · subst hbj; simp [Matrix.transvection, Matrix.mul_add, mul_comm]
  · simp [Matrix.transvection, Matrix.mul_add, hbj]

name: isTransvec_append
proof:
:=
  fun E hE ↦ (List.mem_append.mp hE).elim (h₁ E) (h₂ E)

name: col0_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma col0_ne_zero {m : ℕ} (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ) :
    ∃ i, σ.1 i 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  exact absurd (Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_column_eq_zero 0 (fun i ↦ h i)) (by rw [σ.2]; norm_num)

name: exists_two_nz
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nzCount] at h
  have h1 : 1 < (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin (m+1) ↦ σ.1 i 0 ≠ 0).card := by lia
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp h1
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi hj
  exact ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj⟩

name: col0_euclidean_step_aux
statement:
private lemma col0_euclidean_step_aux {m : ℕ} (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (m+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (hj : σ.1 j 0 ≠ 0)
    (hle : (σ.1 j 0).natAbs ≤ (σ.1 i 0).natAbs) :
    col0Sum (slTransvecG i j hij (-(σ.1 i 0 / σ.1 j 0)) * σ) < col0Sum σ
proof:
:= by
  set q := σ.1 i 0 / σ.1 j 0
  have h_new : (slTransvecG i j hij (-q) * σ).1 i 0 = σ.1 i 0 % σ.1 j 0 := by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp only [ite_true]
    linarith [(Int.mul_ediv_add_emod (σ.1 i 0) (σ.1 j 0)).symm]
  have h_oth : ∀ a, a ≠ i → (slTransvecG i j hij (-q) * σ).1 a 0 = σ.1 a 0 :=
    fun a ha ↦ by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [ha]
  have h_rem : (σ.1 i 0 % σ.1 j 0).natAbs < (σ.1 j 0).natAbs := by
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (σ.1 i 0) hj
    have h2 : σ.1 i 0 % σ.1 j 0 < |σ.1 j 0| := by
      rw [← Int.emod_abs]; exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (abs_pos.mpr hj)
    exact_mod_cast show ((σ.1 i 0 % σ.1 j 0).natAbs : ℤ) < (σ.1 j 0).natAbs from by
      rw [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg h1, Int.natCast_natAbs]; exact h2
  simp only [col0Sum]
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i),
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have h_rest : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      ((slTransvecG i j hij (-q) * σ).1 k 0).natAbs =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (σ.1 k 0).natAbs :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by rw [h_oth k (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1]
  rw [h_rest, h_new]; linarith [Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h_rem hle]

name: col0_euclidean_step
statement:
private lemma col0_euclidean_step {m : ℕ} (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (h : 2 ≤ nzCount σ) :
    ∃ (i j : Fin (m+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ),
      col0Sum (slTransvecG i j hij c * σ) < col0Sum σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i₀, j₀, hij₀, hi₀, hj₀⟩ := exists_two_nz σ h
  by_cases hge : (σ.1 j₀ 0).natAbs ≤ (σ.1 i₀ 0).natAbs
  · exact ⟨i₀, j₀, hij₀, _, col0_euclidean_step_aux σ i₀ j₀ hij₀ hj₀ hge⟩
  · push Not at hge
    exact ⟨j₀, i₀, hij₀.symm, _, col0_euclidean_step_aux σ j₀ i₀ hij₀.symm hi₀ hge.le⟩

name: col0_reduce
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ),
      col0Sum τ ≤ k → ∃ (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
        (∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E) ∧ nzCount (L.prod * τ) ≤ 1 from
    key (col0Sum σ) σ le_rfl
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ k ihk =>
  intro τ hk
  by_cases hn : nzCount τ ≤ 1
  · exact ⟨[], fun _ h ↦ absurd h (by simp), by simp; exact hn⟩
  · push Not at hn
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, c, hlt⟩ := col0_euclidean_step τ hn
    set τ' := slTransvecG i j hij c * τ
    have hlt' : col0Sum τ' < k := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hk
    obtain ⟨L, hL, hL_nz⟩ := ihk (col0Sum τ') hlt' τ' le_rfl
    exact ⟨L ++ [slTransvecG i j hij c], fun E hE ↦ by
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hE
      exact hE.elim (hL E) (fun h ↦ h ▸ ⟨i, j, hij, c, rfl⟩),
      by rw [List.prod_append, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, mul_assoc]; exact hL_nz⟩

name: slTransvecG_inv
statement:
private lemma slTransvecG_inv {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ) :
    (slTransvecG i j hij c)⁻¹ = slTransvecG i j hij (-c)
proof:
:=
  mul_left_cancel (a := slTransvecG i j hij c) <| by
    rw [mul_inv_cancel, slTransvecG_mul, add_neg_cancel, slTransvecG_zero]

name: isTransvec_inv
statement:
private lemma isTransvec_inv {m : ℕ} {E : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ}
    (hE : IsTransvec E) : IsTransvec E⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, c, rfl⟩ := hE
  rw [slTransvecG_inv]; exact ⟨i, j, hij, -c, rfl⟩

name: transvec_list_inv
statement:
private lemma transvec_list_inv {m : ℕ} (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ))
    (hL : ∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E) :
    ∃ L' : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ),
      (∀ E ∈ L', IsTransvec E) ∧ L.prod⁻¹ = L'.prod
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(L.map (·⁻¹)).reverse, fun E hE ↦ ?_, List.prod_inv_reverse L⟩
  rw [List.mem_reverse, List.mem_map] at hE
  obtain ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩ := hE; exact isTransvec_inv (hL F hF)

name: blockLift_isTransvec
statement:
private lemma blockLift_isTransvec {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ) :
    IsTransvec (blockLift i j hij c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨i.succ, j.succ, fun h ↦ hij (Fin.succ_injective m h), c, rfl⟩

name: blockLift_entry
statement:
private lemma blockLift_entry {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m + 1)) ℤ) (a b : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (blockLift i j hij c * τ).1 a b =
    if a = i.succ then τ.1 i.succ b + c * τ.1 j.succ b else τ.1 a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockLift; exact slTransvecG_mul_entry i.succ j.succ _ c τ a b

name: blockLift_row0
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockLift_entry]; split_ifs with h
  · exact absurd h.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)
  · rfl

name: blockLift_col0
statement:
private lemma blockLift_col0 {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m + 1)) ℤ)
    (hcol : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1), k ≠ 0 → τ.1 k 0 = 0) (a : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (blockLift i j hij c * τ).1 a 0 = τ.1 a 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockLift_entry]; split_ifs with ha
  · subst ha; rw [hcol j.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero j), mul_zero, add_zero]
  · rfl

name: det_lowerRight
proof:
:= by
  change (τ.1.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det = 1
  have hdet : τ.1.det = 1 := τ.2
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (m + 1))
    (fun j _ hj ↦ by simp [h0j j hj])
    (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h)] at hdet
  simpa [Fin.succAbove_zero, h00] using hdet

name: extractBlock_blockLift
statement:
private lemma extractBlock_blockLift {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m + 1)) ℤ)
    (h00 : τ.1 0 0 = 1) (h0j : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → τ.1 0 j = 0)
    (hi0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → τ.1 i 0 = 0) :
    extractBlock (blockLift i j hij c * τ)
      (by rw [blockLift_row0]; exact h00)
      (by intro k hk; rw [blockLift_row0]; exact h0j k hk)
      (by intro k hk; rw [blockLift_col0 _ _ _ _ _ hi0]; exact hi0 k hk) =
    slTransvecG i j hij c * extractBlock τ h00 h0j hi0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero m := ⟨by rintro rfl; exact i.elim0⟩
  apply Subtype.ext; ext a b
  change (blockLift i j hij c * τ).1 a.succ b.succ =
    (slTransvecG i j hij c * extractBlock τ h00 h0j hi0).1 a b
  rw [blockLift_entry i j hij c τ a.succ b.succ,
      slTransvecG_mul_entry i j hij c (extractBlock τ h00 h0j hi0) a b]
  simp only [Fin.succ_inj, extractBlock, Matrix.of_apply]

name: row0Sum_eq_zero_imp_cleared
statement:
private lemma row0Sum_eq_zero_imp_cleared {m : ℕ} (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (hzero : row0Sum σ = 0) (j : Fin (m+1)) (hj : j ≠ 0) : σ.1 0 j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_le : (if (j : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else (σ.1 0 j).natAbs) ≤ row0Sum σ :=
    Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun (j : Fin (m + 1)) ↦ if (j : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else (σ.1 0 j).natAbs)
      (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  simp only [hzero, Fin.val_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hj, ↓reduceIte] at h_le
  exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h_le)

name: row0_clear_step
statement:
private lemma row0_clear_step {m : ℕ} (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (hσ00 : σ.1 0 0 = 1) (hσi0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → σ.1 i 0 = 0) (hzero : row0Sum σ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ E, IsTransvec E ∧ (σ * E).1 0 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (σ * E).1 i 0 = 0) ∧
      row0Sum (σ * E) < row0Sum σ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero (m + 1) := ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero m⟩
  have ⟨j₀, hj₀_nz⟩ : ∃ j : Fin (m + 1),
      (if (j : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else (σ.1 0 j).natAbs) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h; push Not at h
    exact hzero (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ ↦ h j))
  have hj₀ : j₀ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by subst h; simp at hj₀_nz
  have hj₀_val : (j₀ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := Fin.val_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hj₀
  have hj₀_entry : σ.1 0 j₀ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simp [h, hj₀_val] at hj₀_nz
  set E := slTransvecG (0 : Fin (m+1)) j₀ hj₀.symm (-σ.1 0 j₀)
  refine ⟨E, ⟨0, j₀, hj₀.symm, _, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [slTransvecG_mul_right_entry]; simp [hj₀.symm, hσ00]
  · intro i hi; rw [slTransvecG_mul_right_entry]; simp [hj₀.symm, hσi0 i hi]
  · have hclear : (σ * E).1 0 j₀ = 0 := by
      rw [slTransvecG_mul_right_entry]; simp [hσ00]
    have hother : ∀ k, k ≠ j₀ → (σ * E).1 0 k = σ.1 0 k := fun k hk ↦ by
      rw [slTransvecG_mul_right_entry]; simp [hk]
    simp only [row0Sum]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j₀),
        ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j₀)]
    have h_rest : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j₀,
        (if (k : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else ((σ * E).1 0 k).natAbs) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j₀, (if (k : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else (σ.1 0 k).natAbs) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by
        by_cases h0 : (k : ℕ) = 0 <;> simp [h0, hother k (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1]
    rw [h_rest, hclear, show (if (j₀ : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else (0 : ℤ).natAbs) = 0 from by simp]
    simp only [hj₀_val, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
    lia

name: row0_clear
statement:
private lemma row0_clear {m : ℕ} (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (h00 : τ.1 0 0 = 1) (hi0 : ∀ i : Fin (m+1), i ≠ 0 → τ.1 i 0 = 0) :
    ∃ (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E) ∧
      (τ * L.prod).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (m+1), j ≠ 0 → (τ * L.prod).1 0 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i ≠ 0 → (τ * L.prod).1 i 0 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ),
      σ.1 0 0 = 1 → (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → σ.1 i 0 = 0) → row0Sum σ ≤ k →
      ∃ (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
        (∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E) ∧
        (σ * L.prod).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
        (∀ j, j ≠ 0 → (σ * L.prod).1 0 j = 0) ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (σ * L.prod).1 i 0 = 0) from
    key (row0Sum τ) τ h00 hi0 le_rfl
  intro k; induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ k ihk =>
  intro σ hσ00 hσi0 hk
  by_cases hzero : row0Sum σ = 0
  · exact ⟨[], fun _ h ↦ absurd h (by simp), by simp [hσ00],
      fun j hj ↦ by simpa using row0Sum_eq_zero_imp_cleared σ hzero j hj,
      fun i hi ↦ by simp [hσi0 i hi]⟩
  · obtain ⟨E, hE_tv, hσ'00, hσ'i0, hlt⟩ := row0_clear_step σ hσ00 hσi0 hzero
    obtain ⟨L', hL'_tv, hL'_00, hL'_0j, hL'_i0⟩ :=
      ihk (row0Sum (σ * E)) (by lia) (σ * E) hσ'00 hσ'i0 le_rfl
    refine ⟨E :: L',
      fun F hF ↦ (List.mem_cons.mp hF).elim (· ▸ hE_tv) (hL'_tv F), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [List.prod_cons, ← mul_assoc] using hL'_00
    · intro j hj; simpa only [List.prod_cons, ← mul_assoc] using hL'_0j j hj
    · intro i hi; simpa only [List.prod_cons, ← mul_assoc] using hL'_i0 i hi

name: nzCount_le_one_unique_nonzero
statement:
private lemma nzCount_le_one_unique_nonzero {m : ℕ}
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (i₀ : Fin (m+1)) (hi₀ : τ.1 i₀ 0 ≠ 0) (h_nz : nzCount τ ≤ 1) :
    ∀ k, k ≠ i₀ → τ.1 k 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk; by_contra hne
  have h2 : 2 ≤ nzCount τ := calc
    2 = ({i₀, k} : Finset _).card := (Finset.card_pair hk.symm).symm
    _ ≤ nzCount τ := Finset.card_le_card fun x hx ↦ by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact hx.elim (· ▸ hi₀) (· ▸ hne)
  lia

name: sole_nonzero_col0_is_unit
proof:
:= by
  set M := τ.1
  have hdet : M.det = 1 := τ.2
  rw [← Int.isUnit_iff]; apply isUnit_of_dvd_one; rw [← hdet, Matrix.det_apply]
  apply Finset.dvd_sum; intro σ _
  show M i₀ 0 ∣ (↑(Equiv.Perm.sign σ) : ℤ) * ∏ i, M (σ i) i
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  by_cases hσ : σ 0 = i₀
  · rw [hσ, ← mul_assoc]; exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left _ _) _
  · rw [h_others (σ 0) hσ, zero_mul, mul_zero]; exact dvd_zero _

name: block_form_transvec_lift
statement:
private lemma block_form_transvec_lift {m : ℕ} (M : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (H00 : M.1 0 0 = 1) (H0j : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → M.1 0 j = 0)
    (Hi0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → M.1 i 0 = 0)
    (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ)) (hL : ∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E)
    (hL_eq : extractBlock M H00 H0j Hi0 = L.prod) :
    ∃ (L' : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L', IsTransvec E) ∧ M = L'.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing M with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[], fun _ h ↦ absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
    simp only [List.prod_nil] at hL_eq ⊢
    apply Subtype.ext; ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_one, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · subst ha; by_cases hb : b = 0
      · subst hb; exact H00
      · rw [H0j b hb, if_neg (Ne.symm hb)]
    · by_cases hb : b = 0
      · subst hb; rw [Hi0 a ha, if_neg ha]
      · obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq.mpr ha
        obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq.mpr hb
        have h := congr_fun (congr_fun (congr_arg Subtype.val hL_eq) a') b'
        simp only [extractBlock, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_one,
          Matrix.one_apply] at h
        simpa using h
  | cons E L' ihL' =>
    simp only [List.prod_cons] at hL_eq
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, c, rfl⟩ := hL E (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
    have H00' : (blockLift i j hij (-c) * M).1 0 0 = 1 := by
      rw [blockLift_row0]; exact H00
    have H0j' : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → (blockLift i j hij (-c) * M).1 0 k = 0 := by
      intro k hk; rw [blockLift_row0]; exact H0j k hk
    have Hi0' : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → (blockLift i j hij (-c) * M).1 k 0 = 0 := by
      intro k hk; rw [blockLift_col0 _ _ _ _ _ Hi0]; exact Hi0 k hk
    have hext' : extractBlock (blockLift i j hij (-c) * M) H00' H0j' Hi0' = L'.prod :=
      (extractBlock_blockLift i j hij (-c) M H00 H0j Hi0).trans
        (by rw [hL_eq, ← mul_assoc, slTransvecG_mul, neg_add_cancel, slTransvecG_zero, one_mul])
    obtain ⟨L'', hL''_tv, hL''_eq⟩ := ihL'
      (blockLift i j hij (-c) * M) H00' H0j' Hi0'
      (fun F hF ↦ hL F (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hF)) hext'
    refine ⟨blockLift i j hij c :: L'',
      fun F hF ↦ (List.mem_cons.mp hF).elim
        (fun h ↦ h ▸ blockLift_isTransvec i j hij c) (hL''_tv F), ?_⟩
    simp only [List.prod_cons]; rw [← hL''_eq, ← mul_assoc]
    unfold blockLift; rw [slTransvecG_mul, add_neg_cancel, slTransvecG_zero, one_mul]

name: column_pivot_of_neg_one_at_zero
statement:
private lemma column_pivot_of_neg_one_at_zero {m' : ℕ}
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m'+2)) ℤ) (h_neg1 : τ.1 0 0 = -1)
    (h_others : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → τ.1 k 0 = 0) :
    ∃ (L₁ : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m'+2)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L₁, IsTransvec E) ∧ (L₁.prod * τ).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (L₁.prod * τ).1 i 0 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m' + 2)) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have h01 : (0 : Fin (m' + 2)) ≠ 1 := h10.symm
  set σ₁ := slTransvecG (1 : Fin (m' + 2)) 0 h10 1 * τ
  have hσ₁_00 : σ₁.1 0 0 = -1 := by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [h01, h_neg1]
  have hσ₁_10 : σ₁.1 1 0 = -1 := by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [h_neg1, h_others 1 h10]
  have hσ₁_i0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 1 → σ₁.1 i 0 = 0 := fun i hi0 hi1 ↦ by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hi1, h_others i hi0]
  set σ₂ := slTransvecG (0 : Fin (m' + 2)) 1 h01 (-2) * σ₁
  have hσ₂_00 : σ₂.1 0 0 = 1 := by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hσ₁_00, hσ₁_10]
  have hσ₂_10 : σ₂.1 1 0 = -1 := by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [h10, hσ₁_10]
  have hσ₂_i0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 1 → σ₂.1 i 0 = 0 := fun i hi0 hi1 ↦ by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hi0, hσ₁_i0 i hi0 hi1]
  set σ₃ := slTransvecG (1 : Fin (m' + 2)) 0 h10 1 * σ₂
  have hσ₃_00 : σ₃.1 0 0 = 1 := by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [h01, hσ₂_00]
  have hσ₃_i0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → σ₃.1 i 0 = 0 := fun i hi ↦ by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]
    rcases eq_or_ne i 1 with rfl | hi1
    · simp [hσ₂_00, hσ₂_10]
    · simp [hi1, hσ₂_i0 i hi hi1]
  have hprod : [slTransvecG 1 0 h10 1, slTransvecG 0 1 h01 (-2),
      slTransvecG 1 0 h10 1].prod * τ = σ₃ := by
    simp only [List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, mul_assoc, σ₃, σ₂, σ₁]
  exact ⟨[slTransvecG 1 0 h10 1, slTransvecG 0 1 h01 (-2), slTransvecG 1 0 h10 1],
    fun E hE ↦ by
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hE
      rcases hE with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,
    by rw [hprod]; exact hσ₃_00, fun i hi ↦ by rw [hprod]; exact hσ₃_i0 i hi⟩

name: column_pivot_of_unit_off_diagonal
statement:
private lemma column_pivot_of_unit_off_diagonal {m : ℕ} [NeZero (m + 1)]
    (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ) (i₀ : Fin (m+1)) (hi₀_zero : i₀ ≠ 0)
    (h_others : ∀ k, k ≠ i₀ → τ.1 k 0 = 0) (h_unit : τ.1 i₀ 0 = 1 ∨ τ.1 i₀ 0 = -1) :
    ∃ (L₁ : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L₁, IsTransvec E) ∧ (L₁.prod * τ).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (L₁.prod * τ).1 i 0 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hi₀0 : (0 : Fin (m+1)) ≠ i₀ := fun h ↦ hi₀_zero h.symm
  set v := τ.1 i₀ 0 with hv_def
  have hv2 : v * v = 1 := by rcases h_unit with h | h <;> simp [v, h]
  set σ₁ := slTransvecG (0 : Fin (m+1)) i₀ hi₀0 v * τ
  have hσ₁_00 : σ₁.1 0 0 = 1 := by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [h_others 0 hi₀0, ← hv_def, hv2]
  have hσ₁_i₀0 : σ₁.1 i₀ 0 = v := by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hi₀_zero, ← hv_def]
  have hσ₁_other : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → k ≠ i₀ → σ₁.1 k 0 = 0 := fun k hk0 hki₀ ↦ by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hk0, h_others k hki₀]
  set σ₂ := slTransvecG i₀ (0 : Fin (m+1)) hi₀_zero (-v) * σ₁
  have hσ₂_00 : σ₂.1 0 0 = 1 := by rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]; simp [hi₀0, hσ₁_00]
  have hσ₂_i0 : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → σ₂.1 i 0 = 0 := fun i hi ↦ by
    rw [slTransvecG_mul_entry]
    rcases eq_or_ne i i₀ with rfl | hne
    · simp [hσ₁_i₀0, hσ₁_00, add_neg_cancel]
    · simp [hne, hσ₁_other i hi hne]
  have hprod : [slTransvecG i₀ 0 hi₀_zero (-v),
      slTransvecG 0 i₀ hi₀0 v].prod * τ = σ₂ := by
    simp only [List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one, mul_assoc, σ₂, σ₁]
  exact ⟨[slTransvecG i₀ 0 hi₀_zero (-v), slTransvecG 0 i₀ hi₀0 v],
    fun E hE ↦ by
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_nil_iff, or_false] at hE
      rcases hE with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩,
    by rw [hprod]; exact hσ₂_00, fun i hi ↦ by rw [hprod]; exact hσ₂_i0 i hi⟩

name: to_block_form
statement:
private lemma to_block_form {m : ℕ} (τ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)
    (i₀ : Fin (m+1)) (hi₀ : τ.1 i₀ 0 ≠ 0) (h_others : ∀ k, k ≠ i₀ → τ.1 k 0 = 0)
    (h_unit : τ.1 i₀ 0 = 1 ∨ τ.1 i₀ 0 = -1) :
    ∃ (L_left L_right : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L_left, IsTransvec E) ∧ (∀ E ∈ L_right, IsTransvec E) ∧
      (L_left.prod * τ * L_right.prod).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (m+1), j ≠ 0 → (L_left.prod * τ * L_right.prod).1 0 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i ≠ 0 → (L_left.prod * τ * L_right.prod).1 i 0 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero (m + 1) := ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero m⟩
  suffices h_col : ∃ (L₁ : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin (m+1)) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L₁, IsTransvec E) ∧
      (L₁.prod * τ).1 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → (L₁.prod * τ).1 i 0 = 0) by
    obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, h₁_00, h₁_i0⟩ := h_col
    obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, h₂_00, h₂_0j, h₂_i0⟩ :=
      row0_clear (L₁.prod * τ) h₁_00 h₁_i0
    exact ⟨L₁, L₂, hL₁, hL₂, h₂_00, h₂_0j, h₂_i0⟩
  by_cases hi₀_zero : i₀ = 0
  · subst hi₀_zero
    rcases h_unit with h1 | h_neg1
    · exact ⟨[], fun _ h ↦ absurd h (by simp), by simp [h1],
        fun i hi ↦ by simp [h_others i hi]⟩
    rcases m with _ | m'
    · exact absurd (show τ.1.det = -1 by simp [Matrix.det_unique, h_neg1])
        (by rw [τ.2]; norm_num)
    · exact column_pivot_of_neg_one_at_zero τ h_neg1 h_others
  · exact column_pivot_of_unit_off_diagonal τ i₀ hi₀_zero h_others h_unit

name: SLnZ_transvec_gen
statement:
theorem SLnZ_transvec_gen (m : ℕ) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ) :
    ∃ (L : List (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin m) ℤ)),
      (∀ E ∈ L, IsTransvec E) ∧ σ = L.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨[], fun _ h ↦ absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext; ext i; exact i.elim0
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨L_col, hL_col, h_nz⟩ := col0_reduce σ
    set τ := L_col.prod * σ
    have hσ_eq : σ = L_col.prod⁻¹ * τ := by simp [τ]
    obtain ⟨L_inv, hL_inv_tv, hL_inv_eq⟩ := transvec_list_inv L_col hL_col
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := col0_ne_zero τ
    have h_others := nzCount_le_one_unique_nonzero τ i₀ hi₀ h_nz
    have h_unit := sole_nonzero_col0_is_unit τ i₀ h_others
    obtain ⟨L_left, L_right, hL_left, hL_right, h00, h0j, hhi0⟩ :=
      to_block_form τ i₀ hi₀ h_others h_unit
    set τ' := L_left.prod * τ * L_right.prod
    obtain ⟨L_B, hL_B_tv, hL_B_eq⟩ := ih (extractBlock τ' h00 h0j hhi0)
    obtain ⟨L_block, hL_block_tv, hL_block_eq⟩ :=
      block_form_transvec_lift τ' h00 h0j hhi0 L_B hL_B_tv hL_B_eq
    obtain ⟨L_left_inv, hL_left_inv_tv, hL_left_inv_eq⟩ := transvec_list_inv L_left hL_left
    obtain ⟨L_right_inv, hL_right_inv_tv, hL_right_inv_eq⟩ := transvec_list_inv L_right hL_right
    refine ⟨L_inv ++ L_left_inv ++ L_block ++ L_right_inv,
      isTransvec_append _ _ (isTransvec_append _ _
        (isTransvec_append _ _ hL_inv_tv hL_left_inv_tv) hL_block_tv) hL_right_inv_tv, ?_⟩
    rw [List.prod_append, List.prod_append, List.prod_append,
        ← hL_inv_eq, ← hL_left_inv_eq, ← hL_right_inv_eq,
        ← hL_block_eq, hσ_eq]
    show L_col.prod⁻¹ * τ =
      L_col.prod⁻¹ * L_left.prod⁻¹ * (L_left.prod * τ * L_right.prod) * L_right.prod⁻¹
    group

name: SLnZ_coe_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma SLnZ_coe_def (σ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) :
    (σ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = mapGL ℚ σ
proof: := rfl

name: coe_mem_SLnZ
statement:
lemma coe_mem_SLnZ (σ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) :
    (σ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n
proof: := ⟨σ, rfl⟩

name: SLnZ_subgroup_hasIntEntries
statement:
lemma SLnZ_subgroup_hasIntEntries {g : GL (Fin n) ℚ} (hg : g ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n) :
    HasIntEntries n g
proof:
:=
  let ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hg
  ⟨σ.val, hσ ▸ by simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq]⟩

name: hasIntEntries_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hasIntEntries_one : HasIntEntries n (1 : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, by ext i j; simp [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply]⟩

name: HasIntEntries.mul
statement:
lemma HasIntEntries.mul {a b : GL (Fin n) ℚ} (ha : HasIntEntries n a) (hb : HasIntEntries n b) :
    HasIntEntries n (a * b)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨A, hA⟩ := ha; let ⟨B, hB⟩ := hb
  ⟨A * B, by ext i j; simp [hA, hB, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply]⟩

name: det_intMat_cast
statement:
lemma det_intMat_cast (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) :
    (A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)).det = (A.det : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) = (Int.castRingHom ℚ).mapMatrix A by
    ext i j; simp [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply], ← RingHom.map_det,
    Int.coe_castRingHom]

name: intMat_map_mul
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply]

name: SLnZ_le_posDetInt
statement: lemma SLnZ_le_posDetInt : (SLnZ_subgroup n).toSubmonoid ≤ posDetInt_submonoid n
proof:
:= by
  rintro g ⟨A, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨A.val, by simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq]⟩, by simp [det_intMat_cast, A.prop]⟩

name: mapGL_injective
statement:
private lemma mapGL_injective : Function.Injective
    (mapGL ℚ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ →* GL (Fin n) ℚ)
proof:
:=
  SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL_injective

name: ker_entry_dvd
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hγ
  have h := congr_fun₂ (congr_arg Subtype.val hγ) i j
  simp [SpecialLinearGroup.map, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply] at h
  rw [Matrix.one_apply] at h ⊢
  split_ifs at h ⊢
  · exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp (by simp [h])
  · rw [sub_zero]
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp h

name: gamma_decompose
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.one_apply] at hgamma
  nlinarith [mul_comm ((gamma i j - if i = j then 1 else 0) / d) d,
    Int.ediv_mul_cancel (hgamma i j)]

name: adjugate_conj_dvd
statement:
private lemma adjugate_conj_dvd (A gamma : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hgamma : ∀ i j : Fin n, A.det ∣ (gamma i j - (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j))
    (i j : Fin n) :
    A.det ∣ (A.adjugate * gamma * A) i j
proof:
:= by
  set M := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (gamma i j - (1 : Matrix _ _ ℤ) i j) / A.det
  have : A.adjugate * gamma * A = A.adjugate * A + A.det • (A.adjugate * M * A) := by
    rw [gamma_decompose n A.det gamma hgamma]
    conv_lhs => rw [mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [this, adjugate_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_right _ _) (dvd_mul_right _ _)

name: det_entrywise_div_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ((Matrix.of fun i j ↦ P i j / d).det : ℚ) = 1 by exact_mod_cast h
  have h_mat_eq : (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ P i j / d).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) =
      (d : ℚ)⁻¹ • (P.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [Int.cast_div (hdvd i j) (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd)]
    ring
  have hdQ : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd
  rw [← det_intMat_cast, h_mat_eq, det_smul, Fintype.card_fin, det_intMat_cast, hdet, inv_pow]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero n hdQ)

name: conj_mat_det_one
proof:
:= by
  apply det_entrywise_div_eq_one n A.det _ hdvd hAdet
  simp only [Matrix.det_mul, det_adjugate, hgamma_det]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_one, Fintype.card_fin, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos (NeZero.pos n)]

name: int_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  set delta := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A.adjugate * gamma * A) i j / A.det
  have ha : A.det • delta = A.adjugate * gamma * A := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply, delta]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (hdvd i j)
  suffices h : A.det • (A * delta) = A.det • (gamma * A) by
    ext i j
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hAdet
      (by simpa [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using congr_fun₂ h i j)
  rw [← mul_smul_comm, ha, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    mul_adjugate, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: conj_ker_mem_SLnZ
statement:
lemma conj_ker_mem_SLnZ (g : GL (Fin n) ℚ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hA : (↑g : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)) (hAdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (γ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hγ : γ ∈ (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod A.det.natAbs))).ker) :
    g⁻¹ * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n
proof:
:= by
  have hnatAbs_ne : NeZero A.det.natAbs := ⟨Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hAdet⟩
  have h_entry : ∀ i j, A.det ∣ (γ.val i j - (1 : Matrix _ _ ℤ) i j) :=
    fun i j ↦ Int.natAbs_dvd.mp (ker_entry_dvd n A.det.natAbs γ hγ i j)
  have hdvd := adjugate_conj_dvd n A γ.val h_entry
  set delta_mat := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A.adjugate * γ.val * A) i j / A.det
  have hdelta_det : delta_mat.det = 1 := conj_mat_det_one n A γ.val γ.prop hdvd hAdet
  set delta : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ := ⟨delta_mat, hdelta_det⟩
  rw [SLnZ_subgroup, MonoidHom.mem_range]
  refine ⟨delta, ?_⟩
  have h_int_eq : A * delta_mat = γ.val * A := int_mul_eq n A γ.val hAdet hdvd
  have h_mat_eq : (g * (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ)).val = ((γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g).val := by
    change (g.val * (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ).val : Matrix _ _ ℚ) =
      ((γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ).val * g.val : Matrix _ _ ℚ)
    simp only [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq,
      map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Int.coe_castRingHom] at *
    rw [hA, intMat_map_mul, intMat_map_mul, h_int_eq]
  have h_unit_eq : g * (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g := Units.ext h_mat_eq
  rw [show (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = g⁻¹ * ((γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g) by
    rw [← h_unit_eq, inv_mul_cancel_left], mul_assoc]

name: conj_dvd_reverse
statement:
private lemma conj_dvd_reverse (A gamma : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hgamma : ∀ i j : Fin n, A.det ∣ (gamma i j - (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j))
    (i j : Fin n) :
    A.det ∣ (A * gamma * A.adjugate) i j
proof:
:= by
  set M := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (gamma i j - (1 : Matrix _ _ ℤ) i j) / A.det
  have : A * gamma * A.adjugate = A * A.adjugate + A.det • (A * M * A.adjugate) := by
    rw [gamma_decompose n A.det gamma hgamma]
    conv_lhs => rw [mul_add, Matrix.mul_one, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [this, mul_adjugate]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_right _ _) (dvd_mul_right _ _)

name: conj_mat_det_one_reverse
statement:
private lemma conj_mat_det_one_reverse
    (A gamma : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hgamma_det : gamma.det = 1)
    (hdvd : ∀ i j : Fin n, A.det ∣ (A * gamma * A.adjugate) i j) (hAdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A * gamma * A.adjugate) i j / A.det).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply det_entrywise_div_eq_one n A.det _ hdvd hAdet
  simp only [Matrix.det_mul, det_adjugate, hgamma_det, Fintype.card_fin]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_one, mul_comm, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos (NeZero.pos n)]

name: int_mul_eq_reverse
proof:
:= by
  set delta := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A * gamma * A.adjugate) i j / A.det
  have ha : A.det • delta = A * gamma * A.adjugate := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply, delta]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (hdvd i j)
  suffices h : A.det • (delta * A) = A.det • (A * gamma) by
    ext i j
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hAdet
      (by simpa [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using congr_fun₂ h i j)
  rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ha, Matrix.mul_assoc, adjugate_mul, mul_smul_comm, Matrix.mul_one]

name: conj_ker_mem_SLnZ_inv
statement:
private lemma conj_ker_mem_SLnZ_inv (g : GL (Fin n) ℚ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hA : (↑g : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)) (hAdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (γ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hγ : γ ∈ (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod A.det.natAbs))).ker) :
    g * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g⁻¹ ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n
proof:
:= by
  have hnatAbs_ne : NeZero A.det.natAbs := ⟨Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hAdet⟩
  have h_entry : ∀ i j, A.det ∣ (γ.val i j - (1 : Matrix _ _ ℤ) i j) :=
    fun i j ↦ Int.natAbs_dvd.mp (ker_entry_dvd n A.det.natAbs γ hγ i j)
  have hdvd := conj_dvd_reverse n A γ.val h_entry
  set delta_mat := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (A * γ.val * A.adjugate) i j / A.det
  have hdelta_det : delta_mat.det = 1 :=
    conj_mat_det_one_reverse n A γ.val γ.prop hdvd hAdet
  set delta : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ := ⟨delta_mat, hdelta_det⟩
  have h_int_eq : delta_mat * A = A * γ.val := int_mul_eq_reverse n A γ.val hAdet hdvd
  have h_mat_eq : ((delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g).val = (g * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ)).val := by
    change ((delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ).val * g.val : Matrix _ _ ℚ) =
      (g.val * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ).val : Matrix _ _ ℚ)
    simp only [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq,
      map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Int.coe_castRingHom] at *
    rw [hA, intMat_map_mul, intMat_map_mul, h_int_eq]
  have h_unit_eq : (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g = g * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) := Units.ext h_mat_eq
  rw [SLnZ_subgroup, MonoidHom.mem_range, show g * (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * g⁻¹ =
    (delta : GL (Fin n) ℚ) by rw [← h_unit_eq, mul_inv_cancel_right]]
  exact ⟨delta, rfl⟩

name: congruence_ker_image_relIndex_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  set phi : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ →* SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) (ZMod d) :=
    SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod d))
  rw [show SLnZ_subgroup n =
      Subgroup.map (mapGL ℚ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ →* GL (Fin n) ℚ) ⊤ by
        simp [SLnZ_subgroup, MonoidHom.range_eq_map],
    Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ (mapGL_injective n),
    Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
  exact (Subgroup.finiteIndex_ker phi).index_ne_zero

name: congruence_ker_image_le_conj
statement:
private lemma congruence_ker_image_le_conj (g : GL (Fin n) ℚ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hA : (↑g : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)) (hAdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Subgroup.map (mapGL ℚ) (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod A.det.natAbs))).ker ≤
      ConjAct.toConjAct g • SLnZ_subgroup n
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨γ, hγ_ker, rfl⟩
  rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  change (ConjAct.toConjAct g)⁻¹ • (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n
  rw [ConjAct.smul_def, ConjAct.ofConjAct_inv, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct]
  exact conj_ker_mem_SLnZ n g A hA hAdet γ hγ_ker

name: congruence_ker_image_le_conj_inv
statement:
private lemma congruence_ker_image_le_conj_inv (g : GL (Fin n) ℚ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hA : (↑g : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = A.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ)) (hAdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Subgroup.map (mapGL ℚ) (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod A.det.natAbs))).ker ≤
      ConjAct.toConjAct g⁻¹ • SLnZ_subgroup n
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨γ, hγ_ker, rfl⟩
  rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  simp only [ConjAct.toConjAct_inv, inv_inv]
  change ConjAct.toConjAct g • (γ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) ∈ SLnZ_subgroup n
  rw [ConjAct.smul_def, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct]
  exact conj_ker_mem_SLnZ_inv n g A hA hAdet γ hγ_ker

name: posDetInt_le_commensurator
statement:
lemma posDetInt_le_commensurator :
    posDetInt_submonoid n ≤ (commensurator (SLnZ_subgroup n)).toSubmonoid
proof:
:= by
  intro g ⟨⟨A, hA⟩, hdet⟩
  rw [Subgroup.mem_toSubmonoid, commensurator_mem_iff]
  set H := SLnZ_subgroup n
  have hAdet_ne : A.det ≠ 0 :=
    (Int.cast_pos.mp (by rw [← det_intMat_cast, ← hA]; exact hdet : (0 : ℚ) < (A.det : ℚ))).ne'
  have hnatAbs_ne : NeZero A.det.natAbs := ⟨Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hAdet_ne⟩
  set K := (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod A.det.natAbs))).ker.map
    (mapGL ℚ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ →* GL (Fin n) ℚ)
  have hK_relIndex : K.relIndex H ≠ 0 := congruence_ker_image_relIndex_ne_zero n A.det.natAbs
  have hK_le_gH : K ≤ ConjAct.toConjAct g • H := congruence_ker_image_le_conj n g A hA hAdet_ne
  have hK_le_ginvH : K ≤ ConjAct.toConjAct g⁻¹ • H :=
    congruence_ker_image_le_conj_inv n g A hA hAdet_ne
  refine ⟨ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hK_relIndex (Subgroup.relIndex_dvd_of_le_left H hK_le_gH), ?_⟩
  have h1 : ConjAct.toConjAct g⁻¹ • (ConjAct.toConjAct g • H) = H := by
    rw [smul_smul, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_smul]
  rw [(Subgroup.relIndex_pointwise_smul (ConjAct.toConjAct g⁻¹) H
    (ConjAct.toConjAct g • H)).symm.trans (by rw [h1])]
  exact ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hK_relIndex (Subgroup.relIndex_dvd_of_le_left H hK_le_ginvH)

name: natAbs_emod_lt
statement: private lemma natAbs_emod_lt (a c : ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 0) : (a % c).natAbs < c.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.natAbs_emod a hc]
  split
  · exact Nat.mod_lt _ (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hc)
  · rename_i h
    push Not at h
    have : a.natAbs % c.natAbs ≠ 0 :=
      fun heq ↦ h.2 (Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero heq))
    omega

name: isCoprime_emod
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (a₁ % c₁ : ℤ) = a₁ + c₁ * (-(a₁ / c₁)) from by rw [Int.emod_def]; ring]
  push_cast
  exact hac.symm.add_mul_left_right _

name: IsCoprime.lift_to_int
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.lift_to_int {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] {a c : ZMod d} (hac : IsCoprime a c) :
    ∃ a₀ c₀ : ℤ, (a₀ : ZMod d) = a ∧ (c₀ : ZMod d) = c ∧ IsCoprime a₀ c₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₁, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  obtain ⟨c₁, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective c
  suffices h : ∀ n, ∀ a₁ c₁ : ℤ, c₁.natAbs ≤ n →
      IsCoprime (a₁ : ZMod d) (c₁ : ZMod d) →
      ∃ a₀ c₀ : ℤ, (a₀ : ZMod d) = a₁ ∧ (c₀ : ZMod d) = c₁ ∧ IsCoprime a₀ c₀ from
    h c₁.natAbs a₁ c₁ le_rfl hac
  
  have zero_case : ∀ a₁ : ℤ, IsCoprime (a₁ : ZMod d) 0 →
      ∃ a₀ c₀ : ℤ, (a₀ : ZMod d) = a₁ ∧ (c₀ : ZMod d) = 0 ∧ IsCoprime a₀ c₀ := fun a₁ hac ↦ by
    have hunit : IsUnit (a₁ : ZMod d) := by rwa [isCoprime_zero_right] at hac
    rw [ZMod.coe_int_isUnit_iff_isCoprime] at hunit
    exact ⟨a₁, d, rfl, by simp, hunit.symm⟩
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro a₁ c₁ hle hac
    have hc₁ : c₁ = 0 := by omega
    subst hc₁
    simpa using zero_case a₁ (by simpa using hac)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a₁ c₁ hle hac
    by_cases hc₁ : c₁ = 0
    · subst hc₁; simpa using zero_case a₁ (by simpa using hac)
    obtain ⟨c₀, r₀, hc₀, hr₀, hcop⟩ := ih c₁ (a₁ % c₁)
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp ((natAbs_emod_lt a₁ c₁ hc₁).trans_le hle)) (isCoprime_emod hac)
    refine ⟨r₀ + a₁ / c₁ * c₀, c₀, ?_, hc₀, hcop.symm.add_mul_right_left _⟩
    change ((r₀ + a₁ / c₁ * c₀ : ℤ) : ZMod d) = (a₁ : ZMod d)
    conv_rhs => rw [show a₁ = a₁ % c₁ + a₁ / c₁ * c₁ from by
      have := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod a₁ c₁; linarith]
    push_cast
    rw [hr₀, hc₀]

name: isCoprime_of_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_det_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {a b c d : R} (h : a * d - b * c = 1) : IsCoprime a c
proof:
:=
  ⟨d, -b, by linear_combination h⟩

name: SL2_eq_upperUniTri
statement:
theorem SL2_eq_upperUniTri {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (h : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)
    (h00 : h 0 0 = 1) (h10 : h 1 0 = 0) :
    h = ⟨!![1, h 0 1; 0, 1], by
      rw [det_fin_two]; simp [cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction h using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a b c dd hdet =>
    simp at h00 h10
    subst h00; subst h10
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]
    linear_combination hdet

name: upperUniTri_mem_range
statement:
theorem upperUniTri_mem_range (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (t : ZMod d) :
    ∃ σ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ,
      SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod d)) σ =
      (⟨!![1, t; 0, 1], by rw [det_fin_two]; simp [cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]⟩ :
        SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod d))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t₀, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective t
  refine ⟨⟨!![1, t₀; 0, 1], by rw [det_fin_two]; simp [cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]⟩, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  simp [map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, map_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp

name: inv_mul_10_eq_zero
statement:
theorem inv_mul_10_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (M g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)
    (h0 : M 0 0 = g 0 0) (h1 : M 1 0 = g 1 0) : (M⁻¹ * g) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction M using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a₁ b₁ c₁ d₁ hdet₁ =>
  induction g using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a₂ b₂ c₂ d₂ hdet₂ =>
    simp at h0 h1
    subst h0; subst h1
    simp [coe_inv, adjugate_fin_two, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, of_apply,
      cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]
    ring

name: inv_mul_00_eq_one
statement:
theorem inv_mul_00_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (M g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)
    (h0 : M 0 0 = g 0 0) (h1 : M 1 0 = g 1 0) : (M⁻¹ * g) 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction M using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a₁ b₁ c₁ d₁ hdet₁ =>
  induction g using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a₂ b₂ c₂ d₂ hdet₂ =>
    simp at h0 h1
    subst h0; subst h1
    simp [coe_inv, adjugate_fin_two, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, of_apply,
      cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]
    linear_combination hdet₁

name: SL2_reduction_surjective
statement:
theorem SL2_reduction_surjective (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    Function.Surjective (SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod d)) :
      SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ →* SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod d))
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  induction g using fin_two_induction with
  | _ a b c dd hdet =>
    obtain ⟨a₀, c₀, ha₀, hc₀, hcop⟩ :=
      IsCoprime.lift_to_int (isCoprime_of_det_eq_one hdet)
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ0, hσ1⟩ := hcop.exists_SL2_col (0 : Fin 2)
    set M := SpecialLinearGroup.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod d)) σ
    have hdet' : (!![a, b; c, dd] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod d)).det = 1 := by
      rw [det_fin_two]; change a * dd - b * c = 1; exact hdet
    set g₀ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod d) := ⟨!![a, b; c, dd], hdet'⟩
    have hcol0 : M 0 0 = g₀ 0 0 := by
      simp [M, g₀, map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, map_apply, hσ0, ha₀]
    have hcol1 : M 1 0 = g₀ 1 0 := by
      simp [M, g₀, map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, map_apply, hσ1, hc₀,
        cons_val_one]
    set t := (M⁻¹ * g₀) 0 1
    have hQ : M⁻¹ * g₀ = ⟨!![1, t; 0, 1], by
        rw [det_fin_two]; simp [cons_val_zero, cons_val_one]⟩ :=
      SL2_eq_upperUniTri _ (inv_mul_00_eq_one M g₀ hcol0 hcol1)
        (inv_mul_10_eq_zero M g₀ hcol0 hcol1)
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := upperUniTri_mem_range d t
    refine ⟨σ * τ, ?_⟩
    change _ = g₀
    rw [map_mul, show g₀ = M * (M⁻¹ * g₀) by group, hQ, ← hτ]

name: conjAct_smul_eq_of_mem
statement:
private lemma conjAct_smul_eq_of_mem {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G)
    {h : G} (hh : h ∈ H) : ConjAct.toConjAct h • H = H
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.conjAct_pointwise_smul_eq_self (Subgroup.le_normalizer hh)

name: mapGL_injective
statement: private lemma mapGL_injective : Function.Injective (mapGL ℚ : SL(n, ℤ) →* GL (Fin n) ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy; ext i j
  have h := congr_arg (fun g ↦ (Units.val g) i j) hxy
  simp only [mapGL_coe_matrix, map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply,
    Matrix.map_apply] at h; exact_mod_cast h

name: a1_eq_a0_mul_pk
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel h_dvd_a
  rw [h_ratio] at h1
  push_cast [← h1]; ring

name: conj_diagMat_mem_of_Gamma0
statement:
private lemma conj_diagMat_mem_of_Gamma0 (a : Fin 2 → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (k : ℕ)
    (h_ratio : a 1 / a 0 = p ^ k) (h_dvd_a : a 0 ∣ a 1) (σ : SL(2, ℤ))
    (hσ : (↑(p ^ k) : ℤ) ∣ σ.1 1 0) :
    (diagMat 2 a)⁻¹ * (σ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) * diagMat 2 a ∈ SLnZ_subgroup 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hσ
  let τ_mat : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ :=
    !![σ.1 0 0, ↑(p ^ k) * σ.1 0 1; c, σ.1 1 1]
  have h_det : τ_mat.det = 1 := by
    simp only [τ_mat, Matrix.det_fin_two, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    have hσ_det := σ.prop; simp only [Matrix.det_fin_two] at hσ_det
    rw [hc] at hσ_det; linarith
  let τ : SL(2, ℤ) := ⟨τ_mat, h_det⟩
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range]
  refine ⟨τ, ?_⟩
  have ha1 := a1_eq_a0_mul_pk h_ratio h_dvd_a
  have hcQ : (σ.1 1 0 : ℚ) = (↑(p ^ k) : ℚ) * (c : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  push_cast at ha1 hcQ
  suffices h : diagMat 2 a * (τ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) = (σ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) * diagMat 2 a by
    have h' := congr_arg ((diagMat 2 a)⁻¹ * ·) h
    simp only [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul] at h'; exact h'
  apply Units.ext
  have hval : ∀ μ : SL(2, ℤ), (↑(mapGL ℚ μ) : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = μ.val.map (Int.cast) :=
    fun μ ↦ by simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
  simp only [Units.val_mul, hval]
  ext i j
  simp only [diagMat_val 2 a ha, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.map_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [τ, τ_mat, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Fin.isValue] <;>
    push_cast <;> (try rw [hcQ]) <;> (try rw [ha1]) <;> ring

name: Gamma0_of_conj_diagMat_mem
statement:
private lemma Gamma0_of_conj_diagMat_mem (a : Fin 2 → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (k : ℕ)
    (h_ratio : a 1 / a 0 = p ^ k) (h_dvd_a : a 0 ∣ a 1) (σ : SL(2, ℤ))
    (hmem : (diagMat 2 a)⁻¹ * (σ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) * diagMat 2 a ∈ SLnZ_subgroup 2) :
    (↑(p ^ k) : ℤ) ∣ σ.1 1 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range] at hmem
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hmem
  have ha1 := a1_eq_a0_mul_pk h_ratio h_dvd_a
  have ha0_ne : (a 0 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ha 0).ne'
  have h_mul : diagMat 2 a * (τ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) = (σ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) * diagMat 2 a := by
    have := congr_arg (diagMat 2 a * ·) hτ
    simp only [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul] at this; exact this
  have h_entry : (a 1 : ℚ) * (τ.1 1 0 : ℚ) = (σ.1 1 0 : ℚ) * (a 0 : ℚ) := by
    have h10 := Units.ext_iff.mp h_mul
    have := congr_arg (fun M => M 1 0) h10
    simpa only [Units.val_mul, mapGL_coe_matrix, map_apply_coe, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply,
      diagMat_val 2 a ha, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
      Matrix.map_apply, algebraMap_int_eq, eq_intCast] using this
  have h_σ₁₀ : (σ.1 1 0 : ℚ) = ↑(p ^ k) * (τ.1 1 0 : ℚ) := by
    rw [ha1] at h_entry; field_simp at h_entry ⊢; linarith
  exact ⟨τ.1 1 0, by exact_mod_cast h_σ₁₀⟩

name: conjDiag_relIndex_eq_Gamma0_index
statement:
private lemma conjDiag_relIndex_eq_Gamma0_index (p : ℕ) (a : Fin 2 → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (k : ℕ) (h_ratio : a 1 / a 0 = p ^ k) (h_dvd_a : a 0 ∣ a 1) :
    (ConjAct.toConjAct (diagMat 2 a) • SLnZ_subgroup 2).relIndex (SLnZ_subgroup 2) =
    (Gamma0 (p ^ k)).index
proof:
:= by
  set H := SLnZ_subgroup 2
  set α := diagMat 2 a
  set f := (mapGL ℚ : SL(2, ℤ) →* GL (Fin 2) ℚ)
  have h_inj : Function.Injective f := mapGL_injective 2
  have h_H_eq : H = Subgroup.map f ⊤ := MonoidHom.range_eq_map f
  have h_gamma0_iff : ∀ σ : SL(2, ℤ),
      σ ∈ Gamma0 (p ^ k) ↔ α⁻¹ * f σ * α ∈ H := by
    intro σ
    rw [Gamma0_mem, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    exact ⟨conj_diagMat_mem_of_Gamma0 a ha k h_ratio h_dvd_a σ,
           Gamma0_of_conj_diagMat_mem a ha k h_ratio h_dvd_a σ⟩
  have h_inf_eq : (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H) ⊓ H = Subgroup.map f (Gamma0 (p ^ k)) := by
    ext g; simp only [Subgroup.mem_inf, Subgroup.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h_smul, h_mem⟩
      rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ConjAct.smul_def,
        ConjAct.ofConjAct_inv, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct, inv_inv] at h_smul
      obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := h_mem
      exact ⟨σ, (h_gamma0_iff σ).mpr h_smul, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨σ, rfl⟩⟩
      rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ConjAct.smul_def,
        ConjAct.ofConjAct_inv, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct, inv_inv]
      exact (h_gamma0_iff σ).mp hσ
  calc (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H).relIndex H
      = ((ConjAct.toConjAct α • H) ⊓ H).relIndex H :=
          (Subgroup.inf_relIndex_right _ _).symm
    _ = (Subgroup.map f (Gamma0 (p ^ k))).relIndex (Subgroup.map f ⊤) := by
          rw [h_inf_eq, h_H_eq]
    _ = (Gamma0 (p ^ k)).relIndex ⊤ :=
          Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ h_inj
    _ = (Gamma0 (p ^ k)).index := (Gamma0 (p ^ k)).relIndex_top_right

name: HeckeCoset_deg_T_diag_two_prime
statement:
theorem HeckeCoset_deg_T_diag_two_prime (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (a : Fin 2 → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hdiv : DivChain 2 a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (h_ratio : a 1 / a 0 = p ^ k) :
    HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair 2) (T_diag a) = ↑(p ^ (k - 1) * (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set D := T_diag a
  set δ := (HeckeCoset.rep D : GL (Fin 2) ℚ)
  set α := (diagMat 2 a : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) with hα_def
  set H := (GL_pair 2).H
  have h_dvd_a : a 0 ∣ a 1 := hdiv 0 (by lia)
  have h_in_set : δ ∈ HeckeCoset.toSet D := HeckeCoset.rep_mem D
  have h_D_set : HeckeCoset.toSet D = DoubleCoset.doubleCoset α ↑H ↑H := by
    simp only [D, T_diag, HeckeCoset.toSet_mk, hα_def]; congr 1; exact diagMat_delta_val 2 a ha
  rw [h_D_set, DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset] at h_in_set
  obtain ⟨σ₁, hσ₁, σ₂, hσ₂, hδ_eq⟩ := h_in_set
  have h_smul_σ₁ : ConjAct.toConjAct σ₁ • H = H := conjAct_smul_eq_of_mem H hσ₁
  have h_δ_smul : ConjAct.toConjAct δ • H =
      ConjAct.toConjAct σ₁ • (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H) := by
    rw [hδ_eq, map_mul, map_mul, ← smul_smul, ← smul_smul, conjAct_smul_eq_of_mem H hσ₂]
  have h_S1 : (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H).relIndex H =
      (ConjAct.toConjAct δ • H).relIndex H := by
    rw [h_δ_smul]
    have := Subgroup.relIndex_pointwise_smul
      (ConjAct.toConjAct σ₁) (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H) H
    rw [h_smul_σ₁] at this; exact this.symm
  have h_def : HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair 2) D =
      ↑((ConjAct.toConjAct δ • H).relIndex H) := by
    simp only [HeckeCoset_deg]; rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]; rfl
  have h_Gamma0 : (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H).relIndex H =
      (Gamma0 (p ^ k)).index := conjDiag_relIndex_eq_Gamma0_index p a ha k h_ratio h_dvd_a
  rw [h_def, show (ConjAct.toConjAct δ • H).relIndex H =
      (ConjAct.toConjAct α • H).relIndex H from h_S1.symm,
    h_Gamma0, Gamma0_prime_power_index p hp k hk]

name: diagMat_comm_of_const
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [Units.val_mul, diagMat_val n a ha]
  have h_diag : Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (a i : ℚ)) =
      (a 0 : ℚ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; simp [h_const]
    · simp
  rw [h_diag, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul, mul_one]

name: HeckeCoset_deg_T_diag_two_scalar
statement:
theorem HeckeCoset_deg_T_diag_two_scalar (a : Fin 2 → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (_hdiv : DivChain 2 a) (h_eq : a 0 = a 1) : HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair 2) (T_diag a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h_const : ∀ i, a i = a 0 := fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simp [h_eq]
  set D := T_diag a
  set δ := HeckeCoset.rep D
  set H := (GL_pair 2).H
  suffices hsmul : ConjAct.toConjAct (δ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) • H = H by
    have h_def : HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair 2) D =
        ↑((ConjAct.toConjAct (δ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) • H).relIndex H) := by
      simp only [HeckeCoset_deg, Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index,
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]; rfl
    rw [h_def, hsmul, Subgroup.relIndex_self]; simp
  have hδ_mem : (δ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) ∈
      DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (↑(diagMat_delta 2 a)) H H := by
    rw [show DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (↑(diagMat_delta 2 a)) H H = HeckeCoset.toSet D from by
      simp only [D, H, T_diag, HeckeCoset.toSet_mk]]
    exact HeckeCoset.rep_mem D
  rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset] at hδ_mem; obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁, h₂, hh₂, hδ_eq⟩ := hδ_mem
  have h_comm : diagMat 2 a * h₂ = h₂ * diagMat 2 a :=
    diagMat_comm_of_const 2 a ha h_const h₂
  have hδ_simp : (δ : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) = (h₁ * h₂) * diagMat 2 a := by
    rw [hδ_eq, show (↑(diagMat_delta 2 a) : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) =
        diagMat 2 a from diagMat_delta_val 2 a ha, mul_assoc]
    rw [h_comm, ← mul_assoc]
  have h_diag_conj : ∀ (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ),
      (diagMat 2 a)⁻¹ * g * diagMat 2 a = g := by
    intro g; rw [mul_assoc, ← diagMat_comm_of_const 2 a ha h_const g, ← mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
  rw [hδ_simp, map_mul, ← smul_smul]
  have h_smul_diag : ConjAct.toConjAct (diagMat 2 a) • H = H := by
    ext x
    simp only [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ConjAct.smul_def,
      map_inv, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct, inv_inv, h_diag_conj]
  rw [h_smul_diag]
  exact conjAct_smul_eq_of_mem H (H.mul_mem hh₁ hh₂)

name: ppowDiag_pos
statement:
lemma ppowDiag_pos (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (e : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ∀ i, 0 < ppowDiag n p e i
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ pow_pos hp.pos _

name: divChain_ppow
statement:
lemma divChain_ppow (p : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℕ) (hmono : Monotone e) :
    DivChain n (ppowDiag n p e)
proof:
:= fun _ _ ↦
  Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (hmono (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by omega)))

name: pComponent_monotone
statement:
lemma pComponent_monotone (a : Fin n → ℕ)
    (ha_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (ha : DivChain n a) (p : ℕ) :
    Monotone (pComponent n p a)
proof:
:= fun i j hij ↦
  (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd (ha_pos i).ne' (ha_pos j).ne').mpr
    (divChain_dvd (n := n) ha hij) p

name: removePrime_pos
statement:
lemma removePrime_pos (p : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ) (ha_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) :
    ∀ i, 0 < removePrime n p a i
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ Nat.ordCompl_pos p (ha_pos i).ne'

name: removePrime_divChain
statement:
lemma removePrime_divChain (p : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ) (ha : DivChain n a) :
    DivChain n (removePrime n p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ha i hi
  simp only [removePrime, hk, Nat.ordCompl_mul]
  exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: mul_ppow_remove_eq
statement:
lemma mul_ppow_remove_eq (p : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ppowDiag n p (pComponent n p a) * removePrime n p a = a
proof:
:=
  funext fun i ↦ Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self (a i) p

name: prod_ppow
statement:
lemma prod_ppow (p : ℕ) (e : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ∏ i, (ppowDiag n p e) i = p ^ (∑ i, e i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ppowDiag, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]

name: prod_ppow_remove_coprime
statement:
lemma prod_ppow_remove_coprime (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (a : Fin n → ℕ) (ha_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) :
    Nat.Coprime (∏ i, (ppowDiag n p (pComponent n p a) i))
               (∏ i, (removePrime n p a) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_ppow]
  exact (Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun i _ ↦ Nat.coprime_ordCompl hp (ha_pos i).ne').pow_left _

name: T_elem_congr_diag
statement: lemma T_elem_congr_diag {a b : Fin n → ℕ} (h : a = b) : T_elem a = T_elem b
proof: := h ▸ rfl

name: T_elem_split_prime
statement:
theorem T_elem_split_prime (a : Fin n → ℕ) (ha_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (ha : DivChain n a) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    T_elem a =
    T_elem (ppowDiag n p (pComponent n p a)) *
    T_elem (removePrime n p a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_elem_congr_diag n (mul_ppow_remove_eq n p a).symm]
  exact (T_diag_mul_coprime n _ _ (ppowDiag_pos n p hp _) (removePrime_pos n p a ha_pos)
    (divChain_ppow n p _ (pComponent_monotone n a ha_pos ha p))
    (removePrime_divChain n p a ha) (prod_ppow_remove_coprime n p hp a ha_pos)).symm

name: T_elem_ppow_mem_R_p
statement:
lemma T_elem_ppow_mem_R_p (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (e : Fin n → ℕ) (hmono : Monotone e) :
    T_elem (ppowDiag n p e) ∈ R_p n p hp
proof:
:=
  Subring.subset_closure ⟨e, hmono, rfl⟩

name: pi_mul_pos
statement:
lemma pi_mul_pos (a b : Fin n → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i) :
    ∀ i, 0 < (a * b) i
proof: := fun i ↦ Nat.mul_pos (ha i) (hb i)

name: DivChain_mul
statement:
lemma DivChain_mul (a b : Fin n → ℕ) (ha : DivChain n a) (hb : DivChain n b) :
    DivChain n (a * b)
proof: := fun i hi ↦ Nat.mul_dvd_mul (ha i hi) (hb i hi)

name: diagMat_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma diagMat_mul (a b : Fin n → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i) :
    diagMat n a * diagMat n b = diagMat n (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [diagMat_val _ _ ha, diagMat_val _ _ hb, diagMat_val _ _ (pi_mul_pos n a b ha hb),
    Pi.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Nat.cast_mul]

name: doubleCoset_eq_of_mem'
statement:
private lemma doubleCoset_eq_of_mem' (g δ : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
    (h : g ∈ DoubleCoset.doubleCoset δ (GL_pair n).H (GL_pair n).H) :
    DoubleCoset.doubleCoset g (GL_pair n).H (GL_pair n).H =
      DoubleCoset.doubleCoset δ (GL_pair n).H (GL_pair n).H
proof:
:= by
  rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset] at h
  obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁, h₂, hh₂, heq⟩ := h
  rw [heq]
  exact (DoubleCoset.doubleCoset_mul_right_eq_self (GL_pair n) ⟨h₂, hh₂⟩ (h₁ * δ)).trans
    (doset_mul_left_eq_self (GL_pair n) ⟨h₁, hh₁⟩ δ)

name: nonempty_decompQuot
statement:
private lemma nonempty_decompQuot (D : HeckeCoset (GL_pair n)) :
    Nonempty (decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D))
proof:
:=
  Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp <| by
    simpa [HeckeRing.HeckeCoset_deg] using HeckeRing.HeckeCoset_deg_pos (GL_pair n) D

name: diagMat_scalar_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma diagMat_scalar_eq (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (↑(diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c)) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ) = (c : ℚ) • 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagMat_val _ _ (fun _ ↦ hc), ← Matrix.smul_one_eq_diagonal]

name: diagMat_scalar_comm
statement:
lemma diagMat_scalar_comm (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (g : GL (Fin n) ℚ) :
    diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) * g = g * diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [Units.val_mul, diagMat_scalar_eq n c hc]

name: diagMat_scalar_conj_eq
statement:
lemma diagMat_scalar_conj_eq (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (x : GL (Fin n) ℚ) :
    (diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c))⁻¹ * x * diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, ← diagMat_scalar_comm n c hc x, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]

name: conjAct_scalar_smul_eq
statement:
lemma conjAct_scalar_smul_eq (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ConjAct.toConjAct (diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c)) • (GL_pair n).H = (GL_pair n).H
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ConjAct.smul_def,
    diagMat_scalar_conj_eq n c hc]

name: conjAct_mem_smul_eq
statement:
private lemma conjAct_mem_smul_eq (h : GL (Fin n) ℚ) (hh : h ∈ (GL_pair n).H) :
    ConjAct.toConjAct h • (GL_pair n).H = (GL_pair n).H
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ConjAct.smul_def,
    map_inv, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct, inv_inv]
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_,
    fun hx ↦ (GL_pair n).H.mul_mem ((GL_pair n).H.mul_mem ((GL_pair n).H.inv_mem hh) hx) hh⟩
  rw [show x = h * (h⁻¹ * x * h) * h⁻¹ by group]
  exact (GL_pair n).H.mul_mem ((GL_pair n).H.mul_mem hh hx) ((GL_pair n).H.inv_mem hh)

name: HeckeCoset_deg_scalar
statement:
lemma HeckeCoset_deg_scalar (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair n) (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set D := T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)
  set δ := HeckeCoset.rep D
  set H := (GL_pair n).H
  suffices hsmul : ConjAct.toConjAct (δ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) • H = H by
    have h_def : HeckeCoset_deg (GL_pair n) D =
        ↑((ConjAct.toConjAct (δ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) • H).relIndex H) := by
      simp only [HeckeCoset_deg, Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      rfl
    rw [h_def, hsmul, Subgroup.relIndex_self]
    simp
  have hδ_mem : (δ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) ∈
      DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (↑(diagMat_delta n (fun _ ↦ c))) H H := by
    rw [show DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (↑(diagMat_delta n (fun _ ↦ c))) H H = HeckeCoset.toSet D by
      simp only [D, H, T_diag, HeckeCoset.toSet_mk]]
    exact HeckeCoset.rep_mem D
  rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset] at hδ_mem
  obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁, h₂, hh₂, hδ_eq⟩ := hδ_mem
  have hδ_simp : (δ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = (h₁ * h₂) * diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) := by
    rw [hδ_eq, diagMat_delta_val n (fun _ ↦ c) (fun _ ↦ hc),
      mul_assoc, diagMat_scalar_comm n c hc h₂, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [hδ_simp, map_mul, ← smul_smul, conjAct_scalar_smul_eq n c hc]
  exact conjAct_mem_smul_eq n (h₁ * h₂) (H.mul_mem hh₁ hh₂)

name: mulMap_scalar_eq
statement:
private lemma mulMap_scalar_eq (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb_pos : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (_hb : DivChain n b) (_hcb : DivChain n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b))
    (p : decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c))) ×
      decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag b))) :
    mulMap (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)))
      (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag b)) p =
      T_diag ((fun _ ↦ c) * b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L_c, hL_c, R_c, hR_c, hα_eq⟩ :=
    T_diag_rep_decompose (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) (fun _ ↦ hc)
  obtain ⟨L_b, hL_b, R_b, hR_b, hβ_eq⟩ := T_diag_rep_decompose b hb_pos
  set α := (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)) : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
  set β := (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag b) : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
  set H := (GL_pair n).H
  have h_prod_mem : ↑p.1.out * α * (↑p.2.out * β) ∈
      DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (diagMat n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b) : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
        (GL_pair n).H (GL_pair n).H := by
    rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset]
    refine ⟨(p.1.out : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * L_c * R_c * p.2.out * L_b,
      H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (SetLike.coe_mem p.1.out) hL_c) hR_c)
        (SetLike.coe_mem p.2.out)) hL_b, R_b, hR_b, ?_⟩
    rw [hα_eq, hβ_eq]
    calc ↑p.1.out * (L_c * diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) * R_c) *
          (↑p.2.out * (L_b * diagMat n b * R_b))
        = ↑p.1.out * L_c * (diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) * (R_c * ↑p.2.out * L_b)) *
            (diagMat n b * R_b) := by group
      _ = ↑p.1.out * L_c * ((R_c * ↑p.2.out * L_b) * diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c)) *
            (diagMat n b * R_b) := by rw [diagMat_scalar_comm n c hc _]
      _ = ↑p.1.out * L_c * R_c * ↑p.2.out * L_b *
            (diagMat n (fun _ ↦ c) * diagMat n b) * R_b := by group
      _ = ↑p.1.out * L_c * R_c * ↑p.2.out * L_b *
            diagMat n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b) * R_b := by
          rw [diagMat_mul n _ b (fun _ ↦ hc) hb_pos]
  apply HeckeCoset_ext_toSet (P := GL_pair n)
  rw [mulMap, HeckeCoset.toSet_mk]
  simp only [T_diag, HeckeCoset.toSet_mk,
    diagMat_delta_val n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b) (pi_mul_pos n (fun _ ↦ c) b (fun _ ↦ hc) hb_pos)]
  exact doubleCoset_eq_of_mem' n _ _ h_prod_mem

name: heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_one
statement:
private lemma heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_one (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (b : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hb_pos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hb : DivChain n b) (hab : DivChain n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b)) :
    HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)))
      (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag b))
      (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag ((fun _ ↦ c) * b))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set D_c := T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)
  set D_b := T_diag b
  set D_cb := T_diag ((fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) * b)
  have h_card : Fintype.card (decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)) = 1 := by
    have := HeckeCoset_deg_scalar n c hc
    simp only [HeckeRing.HeckeCoset_deg] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  haveI : Subsingleton (decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)) :=
    Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mp (le_of_eq h_card)
  have h_le : HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c) (HeckeCoset.rep D_b)
      (HeckeCoset.rep D_cb) ≤ 1 := by
    classical
    simp only [HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity]
    norm_cast
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    apply Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr
    constructor
    intro ⟨⟨i₁, j₁⟩, h₁⟩ ⟨⟨i₂, j₂⟩, h₂⟩
    have hi : i₁ = i₂ := Subsingleton.elim i₁ i₂
    subst hi
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h₁ h₂
    have hj := HeckeRing.decompQuot_snd_eq_of_fst_eq (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)
      (HeckeCoset.rep D_b) (HeckeCoset.rep D_cb) i₁ j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂
    subst hj
    rfl
  have h_pos : 0 < HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)
      (HeckeCoset.rep D_b) (HeckeCoset.rep D_cb) := by
    have h_mem : D_cb ∈ HeckeRing.mulSupport (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)
        (HeckeCoset.rep D_b) := by
      simp only [HeckeRing.mulSupport, Finset.top_eq_univ, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ,
        true_and, Prod.exists]
      have ⟨i₀⟩ : Nonempty (decompQuot (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep D_c)) :=
        Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (h_card ▸ Nat.one_pos)
      have ⟨j₀⟩ := nonempty_decompQuot n D_b
      exact ⟨i₀, j₀, mulMap_scalar_eq n c hc b hb_pos hb hab (i₀, j₀)⟩
    exact HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity_pos_of_mem (GL_pair n) _ _ _ h_mem
  lia

name: heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_zero
statement:
private lemma heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_zero (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (b : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hb_pos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hb : DivChain n b) (hab : DivChain n ((fun _ ↦ c) * b))
    (A : HeckeCoset (GL_pair n)) (hA : A ≠ T_diag ((fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) * b)) :
    HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity (GL_pair n) (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)))
      (HeckeCoset.rep (T_diag b)) (HeckeCoset.rep A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HeckeRing.heckeMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_nmem_mulSupport
  intro h_mem
  simp only [HeckeRing.mulSupport, Finset.top_eq_univ, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ,
    true_and] at h_mem
  obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, heq⟩ := h_mem
  exact hA (heq.symm.trans (mulMap_scalar_eq n c hc b hb_pos hb hab (i, j)))

name: T_diag_scalar_mul
statement:
theorem T_diag_scalar_mul (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb_pos : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (hb : DivChain n b) :
    T_elem (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) * T_elem b = T_elem ((fun _ ↦ c) * b)
proof:
:= by
  change HeckeRing.T_single (GL_pair n) ℤ (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)) 1 *
      HeckeRing.T_single (GL_pair n) ℤ (T_diag b) 1 =
    HeckeRing.T_single (GL_pair n) ℤ (T_diag ((fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) * b)) 1
  exact HeckeRing.T_single_one_mul_eq_single (GL_pair n) (T_diag (fun _ : Fin n ↦ c)) (T_diag b)
    (T_diag ((fun _ : Fin n ↦ c) * b))
    (heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_one n c hc b hb_pos hb
      (DivChain_mul n _ _ (divChain_const n c) hb))
    (heckeMultiplicity_scalar_eq_zero n c hc b hb_pos hb
      (DivChain_mul n _ _ (divChain_const n c) hb))

name: slTransvec_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [slTransvec, Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix, SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul] using
    Matrix.transvection_mul_transvection_same (n := Fin n) (i := i) (j := j) hij a b

name: slTransvec_congMod
statement:
private lemma slTransvec_congMod (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ)
    (hdc : (d : ℤ) ∣ c) : congMod n d (slTransvec n i j hij c)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l
  simp only [slTransvec, Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix, Matrix.transvection,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.single, Matrix.of_apply, add_sub_cancel_left]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hdc
  · exact dvd_zero _

name: slTransvec_CRT
statement:
private lemma slTransvec_CRT (d d' : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime d d')
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℤ) :
    ∃ τ₁ τ₂ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      slTransvec n i j hij c = τ₁ * τ₂ ∧ congMod n d τ₁ ∧ congMod n d' τ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hbez : ↑(Nat.gcd d d') = (d : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA d d' + ↑d' * Nat.gcdB d d' :=
    Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab d d'
  rw [hcop.gcd_eq_one, Nat.cast_one] at hbez
  refine ⟨slTransvec n i j hij (c * d * Nat.gcdA d d'),
    slTransvec n i j hij (c * d' * Nat.gcdB d d'), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [slTransvec_mul]
    congr 1
    linear_combination c * hbez
  · exact slTransvec_congMod n d i j hij _ ⟨c * Nat.gcdA d d', by ring⟩
  · exact slTransvec_congMod n d' i j hij _ ⟨c * Nat.gcdB d d', by ring⟩

name: congMod_one
statement: private lemma congMod_one (d : ℕ) : congMod n d 1
proof:
:=
  fun i j ↦ by simp [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_one, Matrix.one_apply]

name: congMod_mul
statement:
private lemma congMod_mul (d : ℕ) (a b : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (ha : congMod n d a) (hb : congMod n d b) : congMod n d (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have h2 : ∑ k, (a.1 i k - if i = k then 1 else 0) * b.1 k j =
      (∑ k, a.1 i k * b.1 k j) - b.1 i j := by
    simp [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mem_univ]
  rw [show (∑ k, a.1 i k * b.1 k j) - (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
      (∑ k, (a.1 i k - if i = k then 1 else 0) * b.1 k j) +
      (b.1 i j - if i = j then 1 else 0) by linarith [h2]]
  exact dvd_add (Finset.dvd_sum fun k _ ↦ dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (ha i k) _) (hb i j)

name: congMod_conj
statement:
private lemma congMod_conj (d : ℕ) (σ τ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hτ : congMod n d τ) : congMod n d (σ⁻¹ * τ * σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  simp only [show σ⁻¹ * τ * σ = σ⁻¹ * (τ * σ) by group,
    SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have h_inv : ∀ i' j', ∑ k : Fin n, (σ⁻¹).1 i' k * σ.1 k j' =
      if i' = j' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i' j'
    have : (σ⁻¹).1 * σ.1 = 1 := by rw [← SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, inv_mul_cancel]; rfl
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using congr_fun (congr_fun this i') j'
  have h_inner : ∀ k, ∑ l : Fin n, τ.1 k l * σ.1 l j =
      (∑ l, (τ.1 k l - if k = l then 1 else 0) * σ.1 l j) + σ.1 k j := by
    intro k
    have h2 : ∑ l, (τ.1 k l - if k = l then 1 else 0) * σ.1 l j =
        (∑ l, τ.1 k l * σ.1 l j) - σ.1 k j := by
      simp [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mem_univ]
    linarith
  rw [show (∑ k, (σ⁻¹).1 i k * ∑ l, τ.1 k l * σ.1 l j) - (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
      ∑ k, (σ⁻¹).1 i k * ∑ l, (τ.1 k l - if k = l then 1 else 0) * σ.1 l j by
    have h3 : (∑ k, (σ⁻¹).1 i k * ∑ l, τ.1 k l * σ.1 l j) =
        (∑ k, (σ⁻¹).1 i k * ∑ l, (τ.1 k l - if k = l then 1 else 0) * σ.1 l j) +
        (∑ k, (σ⁻¹).1 i k * σ.1 k j) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      ext k
      rw [h_inner k]
      ring
    rw [h3, h_inv]
    ring]
  exact Finset.dvd_sum fun k _ ↦ dvd_mul_of_dvd_right
    (Finset.dvd_sum fun l _ ↦ dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (hτ k l) _) _

name: CRTProd_mul'
statement:
private lemma CRTProd_mul' (d d' : ℕ) (a b : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (ha : ∃ p q, a = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q)
    (hb : ∃ p q, b = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q) :
    ∃ p q, a * b = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, q₁, rfl, hp₁, hq₁⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl, hp₂, hq₂⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨p₁ * (q₁ * p₂ * q₁⁻¹), q₁ * q₂, by group, ?_, congMod_mul n d' _ _ hq₁ hq₂⟩
  have h := congMod_conj n d q₁⁻¹ p₂ hp₂
  rw [inv_inv] at h
  exact congMod_mul n d _ _ hp₁ h

name: one_in_CRTProd
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, 1, (one_mul 1).symm, congMod_one n d, congMod_one n d'⟩

name: isTransvec_in_CRTProd
statement:
private lemma isTransvec_in_CRTProd (d d' : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime d d')
    (E : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) (hE : IsTransvec E) :
    ∃ p q : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      E = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, c, rfl⟩ := hE
  rw [show slTransvecG i j hij c = slTransvec n i j hij c from Subtype.ext rfl]
  exact slTransvec_CRT n d d' hcop i j hij c

name: list_prod_in_CRTProd
statement:
private lemma list_prod_in_CRTProd (d d' : ℕ) (L : List (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ))
    (hL : ∀ E ∈ L, ∃ p q : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      E = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q) :
    ∃ p q : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      L.prod = p * q ∧ congMod n d p ∧ congMod n d' q
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact one_in_CRTProd n d d'
  | cons E L ihL =>
    simp only [List.prod_cons]
    exact CRTProd_mul' n d d' E L.prod (hL E (by simp))
      (ihL fun F hF ↦ hL F (by simp [hF]))

name: SLnZ_CRT_decomposition
statement:
lemma SLnZ_CRT_decomposition (d d' : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime d d')
    (τ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) :
    ∃ (τ₁ τ₂ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ), τ = τ₁ * τ₂ ∧
      (∀ i j, (d : ℤ) ∣ ((τ₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j -
        if i = j then 1 else 0)) ∧
      (∀ i j, (d' : ℤ) ∣ ((τ₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j -
        if i = j then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL_transvec, hL_prod⟩ := SLnZ_transvec_gen n τ
  rw [hL_prod]
  exact list_prod_in_CRTProd n d d' L
    fun E hE ↦ isTransvec_in_CRTProd n d d' hcop E (hL_transvec E hE)

name: map_intCast_mul_aux
statement:
private lemma map_intCast_mul_aux (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) :
    (A * B).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) = A.map Int.cast * B.map Int.cast
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply]

name: conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ
statement:
private lemma conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ (a : Fin n → ℕ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (_hdiv : DivChain n a)
    (τ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) (hcong : ∀ i j, (∏ k, (a k : ℤ)) ∣
      ((τ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0)) :
    ∃ σ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      (σ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = diagMat n a * (τ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * (diagMat n a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : ∀ i j, (a j : ℤ) ∣ (a i : ℤ) * τ.val i j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      exact dvd_mul_right _ _
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j))
        (by simpa [hij] using hcong i j)) _
  set M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (a i : ℤ) * τ.val i j / (a j : ℤ)
  set diag_a := Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (a i : ℤ)
  have h_int_eq : diag_a * τ.val = M * diag_a := by
    ext i j
    simpa only [diag_a, M, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.of_apply] using
      (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (hdvd i j)).symm
  have h_det_ne : diag_a.det ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [diag_a, Matrix.det_diagonal] using
      ne_of_gt (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_pos.mpr (ha i))
  have hM_det : M.det = 1 := by
    have h := congr_arg Matrix.det h_int_eq
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, τ.prop, mul_one] at h
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ h_det_ne (by rwa [mul_one, mul_comm])).symm
  refine ⟨⟨M, hM_det⟩, ?_⟩
  have h_Q_eq : (diagMat n a : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * (τ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) =
      mapGL ℚ ⟨M, hM_det⟩ * diagMat n a := by
    apply Units.ext
    have hτ_val : (↑(mapGL ℚ τ) : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = τ.val.map (Int.cast) := by
      simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    have hM_val : (↑(mapGL ℚ (⟨M, hM_det⟩ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)) : Matrix _ _ ℚ) =
        M.map (Int.cast) := by
      simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    simp only [Units.val_mul, hτ_val, hM_val, diagMat_val _ _ ha]
    have h_diag_map : (Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (a i : ℤ)).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) =
        Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (a i : ℚ) := Matrix.diagonal_map (by simp)
    rw [← h_diag_map, ← map_intCast_mul_aux, ← map_intCast_mul_aux, h_int_eq]
  exact eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.mpr h_Q_eq.symm

name: inv_conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ
statement:
private lemma inv_conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (_hdiv : DivChain n b) (τ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)
    (hcong : ∀ i j, (∏ k, (b k : ℤ)) ∣
      ((τ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0)) :
    ∃ σ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ,
      (σ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) = (diagMat n b)⁻¹ * (τ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n b
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : ∀ i j, (b i : ℤ) ∣ (b j : ℤ) * τ.val i j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      exact dvd_mul_right _ _
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
        (by simpa [hij] using hcong i j)) _
  set N : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (b j : ℤ) * τ.val i j / (b i : ℤ)
  set diag_b := Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (b i : ℤ)
  have h_int_eq : τ.val * diag_b = diag_b * N := by
    ext i j
    simp only [diag_b, N, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.of_apply]
    calc τ.val i j * (b j : ℤ) = (b j : ℤ) * τ.val i j := mul_comm _ _
      _ = (b j : ℤ) * τ.val i j / (b i : ℤ) * (b i : ℤ) :=
          (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (hdvd i j)).symm
      _ = (b i : ℤ) * ((b j : ℤ) * τ.val i j / (b i : ℤ)) := mul_comm _ _
  have h_det_ne : diag_b.det ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [diag_b, Matrix.det_diagonal] using
      ne_of_gt (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hb i))
  have hN_det : N.det = 1 := by
    have h := congr_arg Matrix.det h_int_eq
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, τ.prop, one_mul] at h
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ h_det_ne (by rwa [mul_one])).symm
  refine ⟨⟨N, hN_det⟩, ?_⟩
  have h_Q_eq : (diagMat n b : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * mapGL ℚ ⟨N, hN_det⟩ =
      (τ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n b := by
    apply Units.ext
    have hτ_val : (↑(mapGL ℚ τ) : Matrix _ _ ℚ) = τ.val.map (Int.cast) := by
      simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    have hN_val : (↑(mapGL ℚ (⟨N, hN_det⟩ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ)) : Matrix _ _ ℚ) =
        N.map (Int.cast) := by
      simp [mapGL_coe_matrix, algebraMap_int_eq, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    simp only [Units.val_mul, hτ_val, hN_val, diagMat_val _ _ hb]
    have h_diag_map : (Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (b i : ℤ)).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) =
        Matrix.diagonal fun i ↦ (b i : ℚ) := Matrix.diagonal_map (by simp)
    rw [← h_diag_map, ← map_intCast_mul_aux, ← map_intCast_mul_aux, h_int_eq]
  exact (eq_inv_mul_of_mul_eq h_Q_eq).trans (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: doubleCoset_mul_coprime_mem
statement:
lemma doubleCoset_mul_coprime_mem (a b : Fin n → ℕ)
    (ha_pos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hb_pos : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (ha : DivChain n a) (hb : DivChain n b) (hcop : Nat.Coprime (∏ i, a i) (∏ i, b i))
    (τ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) ℤ) :
    diagMat n a * (τ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n b ∈
      DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (diagMat n (a * b) : GL (Fin n) ℚ)
        (SLnZ_subgroup n) (SLnZ_subgroup n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ₁, τ₂, hτ, hτ₁, hτ₂⟩ :=
    SLnZ_CRT_decomposition n (∏ i, a i) (∏ i, b i) hcop τ
  have hτ₁_cong : ∀ i j, (∏ k, (a k : ℤ)) ∣
      ((τ₁ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0) := fun i j ↦ by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod]; exact hτ₁ i j
  obtain ⟨σ₁, hσ₁⟩ := conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ n a ha_pos ha τ₁ hτ₁_cong
  have hτ₂_cong : ∀ i j, (∏ k, (b k : ℤ)) ∣
      ((τ₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0) := fun i j ↦ by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod]; exact hτ₂ i j
  obtain ⟨σ₂, hσ₂⟩ := inv_conjugate_congruent_mem_SLnZ n b hb_pos hb τ₂ hτ₂_cong
  rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset]
  refine ⟨(σ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ), coe_mem_SLnZ n σ₁,
    (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ), coe_mem_SLnZ n σ₂, ?_⟩
  have hσ₁' : diagMat n a * (τ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) =
      (σ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n a := by rw [hσ₁]; group
  have hσ₂' : (τ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n b =
      diagMat n b * (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) := by rw [hσ₂]; group
  rw [hτ, map_mul (mapGL ℚ)]
  calc diagMat n a * ((τ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * (τ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ)) * diagMat n b
      = diagMat n a * (τ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) *
          ((τ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n b) := by group
    _ = diagMat n a * (τ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) *
          (diagMat n b * (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ)) := by rw [hσ₂']
    _ = (σ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n a *
          (diagMat n b * (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ)) := by rw [hσ₁']
    _ = (σ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * (diagMat n a * diagMat n b) *
          (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) := by group
    _ = (σ₁ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) * diagMat n (a * b) *
          (σ₂ : GL (Fin n) ℚ) := by rw [diagMat_mul n a b ha_pos hb_pos]

name: mulMap_coprime_eq
statement:
